job_title: Senior System Engineer - HR Data & AI Initiative (m/w/d)
company_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Boehringer Ingelheim's HR function is entering the era of agentic AI. Building on our established AI, we are launching a dedicated Data & AI initiative to reimagine how HR services and processes are delivered across the globe. As Senior AI Expert, you will be the technical and strategic driving force behind this transformation: designing, building and scaling agentic AI solutions that make HR services smarter, faster and more personal for employees, managers and HR experts alike.
You will join the IT Group Functions & Supply Chain (GFS) Global HR Systems team responsible for our core global HR platforms SAP SuccessFactors and act as the central Data & AI lead for the wider IT GFS Human Resources organization, partnering closely with Corporate HR Centers of Excellence, GBS Process Management, HR stakeholders in the countries and other IT functions like the IT Enterprise Service Management team bringing ServiceNow to the center of HR Service Management.
Tasks & responsibilities
  *  Own and drive the Data & AI initiative for HR: define the roadmap, prioritize use cases and lead the transition of HR services and processes towards agentic, AI-first ways of working.
  *  Design, build and industrialize agentic AI solutions and multi-step AI workflows for HR processes using platforms such as SAP Business AI/ SAPJoule, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Dify, ServiceNow Now Assist and more.
  *  Define and safeguard the data foundation for AI in HR: identify and prioritize HR "crown jewel" datasets, drive onboarding of AI-/agentic-AI-ready data products, and ensure data quality, semantics and governance meet the requirements of generative and agentic AI use cases.
  *  Establish and champion agentic AI governance for HR in line with BI's enterprise Responsible AI frameworks: agent lifecycle and ownership, permissions and data boundaries, human oversight, monitoring, and audit readiness.
  *  Build the business case, cost/benefit assessment and prioritization matrix for AI use cases in HR and translate them into a concrete execution roadmap with measurable business outcomes. 

Requirements
  *  Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Human Resources, or a related field, or a Bachelor's degree with more professional experience.
  *  Several years of experience in AI and data-driven solution design, ideally combined with exposure to HR technology, HR processes, or HR IT landscapes within a global organization.
  *  Proven experience leading or significantly contributing to AI, automation, or digital transformation initiatives from ideation through implementation and scaling.
  *  Hands-on experience with SAP Business AI and SAP Joule, including embedded AI capabilities across SAP SuccessFactors and the ability to configure, extend, and govern AI solutions.
  *  Practical knowledge of agentic AI concepts and platforms, including low-code/no-code and code-based AI development environments.
  *  Understanding of AI data foundations, including data products, data quality, semantic and metadata management, and familiarity with enterprise data and AI ecosystems.
  *  Familiarity with HR technology landscapes such as SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, Degreed, Payroll, and Time Management systems.
  *  Strong stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills, combined with strategic thinking, a hands-on approach, experience working across global and cross-functional teams, intercultural awareness
  *  Fluency in English; German language skills are an advantage.

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process. 
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better. 

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

job_title: Principal Data Strategist (m/f/d)
description:
Principal data strategists at Thoughtworks are experienced consultants who work with clients to create winning data solutions that meet business goals. They play a pivotal role in developing modern data architecture approaches that directly address our clients' key business objectives. Their responsibilities span in-depth reviews of current data and technology strategy, targeted data strategy, guiding clients to unlock the full potential of data, and providing high-level roadmaps.

This role entails a mix of advisory responsibilities in data strategy and governance, coupled with a solid delivery-lead role and a breadth of data and AI ecosystem expertise.

This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation to manage. The role is based in Germany and requires regular travel to client sites, up to approximately 50% of your time.

**Job responsibilities**

- You will collaborate closely with clients to understand their business ecosystem and goals, and co-create data and technology strategies aligned with their objectives.
- You will help define a clear vision for the client enterprise to become data-driven and aligned with the overall business strategy.
- You will consult on complex data programs, providing technical leadership and guidance as a data subject-matter expert.
- You will lead and interact with clients across various domains, addressing challenging problems, and collaborate with sales to turn them into viable solutions and winning proposals.
- You will act as a translator between business, data and IT, and communicate data strategy to senior client stakeholders, including C-level.
- You will own the creation of end-to-end viable data solutions, keeping in mind long-term impacts and overseeing program inceptions for new product development.
- You will be responsible for formulating data governance strategies addressing security, privacy and compliance requirements.
- You will enable capability building in data strategy and governance, growing the next generation of data strategists.
- You will create differentiated assets in data strategy and governance to take to market.
- You lead through influence rather than headcount: growing capability and raising delivery standards inside the organisation, while building our presence in the market through thought leadership, ecosystem initiatives and client-facing points of view.

**Job qualifications**

**Technical Skills**

- You have extensive experience as a consultant, with a proven track record of creating data strategy and solutions that drive business value.
- You have solid experience with data platforms and technologies, and can provide advisory and consultative guidance for clients and cross-delivery teams.
- You have experience engaging with C-level stakeholders to influence and enable the operationalization of an enterprise-wide data strategy.
- You have demonstrated leadership abilities, with the capacity to lead technical teams and drive projects to successful completion.
- You are flexible and adaptable across a variety of projects, leveraging technical expertise and leadership to maximise impact.
- You have a track record of ensuring proper data governance policies, including data lineage, quality checks and classification.
- You have experience with AI and ML use cases and landscapes and can influence the build of the right solutions to harness insights from data.
- You have experience building high-level solution frameworks, leveraging paradigms such as data-as-a-product and federated governance where needed.
- You have professional working proficiency in German (B2 minimum, C1 strongly preferred) and can build consensus with mostly technical stakeholders. Exceptional candidates with outstanding data and AI consulting credentials may be considered where German is not yet at this level.

**Consulting and commercial track record**

- You have worked in a consultancy or professional-services environment within the last five years, driving data and AI engagements end to end (recent examples matter more than historical ones).
- You can point to data and AI pursuits you helped win and shape within the last three to five years, including deals from around €3M upwards, and you can speak concretely to their commercial shape, trade-offs and delivery.
- You have grown a practice, capability or go-to-market asset, for example a reusable accelerator taken to market, combining solutioning, sales and delivery with tangible business outcomes.
- You stay conversant with the technology and hands-on enough in at least one relevant area to earn technical credibility with client and delivery teams, while leading primarily on strategy and advisory.
- You bring significant hands-on and leadership experience in data and AI (typically 10+ years) and, above all, the appetite to keep building: growing accounts, teams and capability rather than only overseeing them.

**Professional Skills**

- You understand the importance of stakeholder management and can easily liaise between clients and other key stakeholders, ensuring buy-in and gaining trust along the way.
- You are resilient in ambiguous situations and can adapt your role to approach challenges from multiple perspectives.
- You don't shy away from risks or conflicts, instead you take them on and skillfully manage them.
- You coach, mentor and motivate others and aspire to influence teammates to take positive action and accountability for their work.
- You enjoy influencing others and always advocate for technical excellence while being open to change when needed.
- Cultivating strong partnerships comes naturally to you; you understand how relationship building brings new opportunities to our business.
- You have professional working proficiency in German (B2 minimum, C1 strongly preferred) and can build consensus with mostly technical stakeholders. Exceptional candidates with outstanding data and AI consulting credentials may be considered where German is not yet at this level.

**Other things to know**

**Learning & Development**

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

**Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment**

At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.

Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.

We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment.

**About Thoughtworks**

Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we're pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we've delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let's be extraordinary.

[See here our AI policy.](https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment)

job_title: Data & Analytics Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Festanstellung, Vollzeit · remote

### DAS SIND DEINE AUFGABEN

Du liebst Zahlen? Du liebst es deine Hypothesen aufzustellen und millionenfach bestätigt zu sehen? Du bist auf der Suche nach einer "grünen Wiese" auf der du ganz viel (neu) gestalten kannst? Wir suchen eine:n Data & Analytics Manager (m/w/d) - ab sofort.

- Du **entwickelst Dashboards** und automatisierst regelmäßige Reportings – damit wir schnell und zuverlässig bessere Entscheidungen treffen
- Du entwickelst **Kennzahlen und KPIs** für unterschiedliche Bereiche (z. B. Apps, Websites und Social) und übersetzt Business-Ziele in messbare Metriken.
- Du baust **neue Strukturen und Standards** auf, die unsere Brands als Entscheidungsgrundlage nutzen.
- Du konzipierst **Tagging- und Tracking-Strategien** (z. B. Events, Conversions, Funnels) und misst so die Performance von Inhalten und Kampagnen.
- Du **berätst unsere Teams** bei datengetriebenen Entscheidungen und stärkst unser „Data-First“-Mindset.

### DAS ZEICHNET DICH AUS

- Du hast **mehrjährige Erfahrung** in **Digital/Data Analytics** – idealerweise mit dem Google Toolstack (z. B. Analytics, Looker Studio & Big Query)
- Du denkst **hypothesengetrieben** und lieferst saubere Ableitungen statt Bauchgefühl.
- Du arbeitest **selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich**. Du treibst deinen Verantwortungsbereich mit Leidenschaft voran.
- Du hast **mehrjährige Erfahrung im Online-Marketing** bzw. E-Commerce. Idealerweise im Affiliate-Marketing.
- Du visualisierst komplexe Sachverhalte **einfach & klar** und kommunizierst gerne proaktiv mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern
- Du sprichst **fließend Deutsch** und hast deinen **Wohnsitz in Deutschland**.
- Optional:
    - Du hast A/B-Tests konzipiert und auf dessen Basis bestehende Webseiten optimiert
    - Du hast Monetarisierungsmodelle, wie z. B. Display Ads, integriert

### WAS DICH BEI UNS ERWARTET

- Unsere Brands (z. B. DealDoktor.de, China-Gadgets.de oder Kostenlos.de) erreichen **monatlich eine Millionenreichweite**. Deine Auswertungen und Empfehlungen werden unsere Communities feiern.
- Deine Arbeit beeinflusst direkt die **strategische Entwicklung aller Marken **der Trimexa – du arbeitest souverän und nah mit z. B. Brand Leads und Geschäftsführung.
- **Leidenschaft - **wir brennen für unsere Projekte und wollen andere anstecken. Bei uns kannst du dich weiterentwickeln und deine Fähigkeiten auf das nächste Level bringen.
- **Verantwortung - **Wir packen an und unterstützen einander! Dabei leben wir aktiv mobiles Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle.
- **Mitdenken** - Wir hinterfragen mutig unseren Status Quo. Wir bieten ein Umfeld, in dem über jede (verrückte) Idee gesprochen wird, haben kurze Kommunikationswege, Duz-Kultur vom Praktikanten bis zum CEO. Kein "das haben wir schon immer so gemacht". Du wirst bei uns den Umgang mit Daten auf ein neues Level heben. Dafür bekommst du **viel Gestaltungsfreiheit**.
- **Spaß! **Wir erschaffen herzliche Momente, an die wir uns ein Leben lang erinnern. Wir ziehen an einem Strang, denn gemeinsam können wir viel erreichen und dabei auch noch eine Menge Spaß haben. Warum auch nicht?

job_title: AI & Data Science Engineer – EUV Metrology (m/w/d) 1108-626
company_name: PAPEVE GmbH Der Spezialist für Ingenieure Techniker und Fachpersonal
description:
**Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Hightech-Messtechnik.**

Wie lassen sich hochkomplexe Messdaten in wertvolle Erkenntnisse übersetzen? Wie können Machine Learning und Künstliche Intelligenz dazu beitragen, innovative Messsysteme noch leistungsfähiger, präziser und intelligenter zu machen?

Als **AI & Data Science Engineer – EUV Metrology (m/w/d)** übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle an der Schnittstelle von **Künstlicher Intelligenz, Data Science, Softwareentwicklung und optischer Messtechnik**. Sie entwickeln innovative Lösungen für komplexe Messsysteme und begleiten Ihre Ideen von der explorativen Datenanalyse und Algorithmenentwicklung bis hin zu produktionsreifen und nachhaltig betreibbaren Anwendungen.

Gemeinsam mit einem interdisziplinären und hochqualifizierten Algorithmus-Team erschließen Sie neue Methoden zur Analyse großer und komplexer Datensätze – einschließlich Bilddaten – und leisten damit einen direkten Beitrag zur digitalen Transformation und technologischen Wettbewerbsfähigkeit bei unserem Mandanten – einem Marktführer in seinem Bereich.

### Ihre Rolle

- Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für die **Entwicklung, Implementierung und Ausführung von Datenanalyse-, Prozessoptimierungs- und Machine-Learning-Lösungen** für komplexe und innovative Messsysteme.
- Sie entwickeln und evaluieren **Algorithmen und statistische Modelle** und übertragen diese in robuste, produktionsreife Anwendungen.
- Gemeinsam mit einem funktionsübergreifenden Algorithmus-Team erschließen Sie neue Methoden zur Auswertung großer Datensätze, einschließlich **Bild- und Messdaten**.
- Sie treiben **Digitalisierungs- und KI-Initiativen** voran – von der explorativen Datenanalyse über moderne KI- und agentische KI-Systeme bis hin zu wartbaren und kundenorientierten Lösungen.
- Sie verbinden **Data Science und Software Engineering** und sorgen dafür, dass aus Prototypen belastbare Lösungen für den produktiven Einsatz entstehen.
- Sie unterstützen die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung und Betreuung bestehender ML-Modelle und Data-Science-Anwendungen.
- Mit Ihren **Organisations- und Projektmanagementfähigkeiten** schaffen Sie Freiräume für unsere Expertinnen und Experten, um neue ML-Potenziale in EUV-Metrologie-Anwendungen zu erschließen.
- Sie arbeiten eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus **Algorithmik, Softwareentwicklung, Messtechnik und weiteren technischen Fachbereichen** zusammen.

### Ihr Profil

- Sie verfügen über einen **sehr guten Hochschulabschluss**, vorzugsweise mit Promotion, in einer quantitativen oder technischen Fachrichtung, z. B.:
    - Physik
    - Mathematik
    - Informatik
    - Data Science
    - Künstliche Intelligenz / Artificial Intelligence
    - Elektrotechnik
    - Photonik / Optik
    - Mechatronik
    - Ingenieurwissenschaften
    - oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
- Sie bringen **mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung** in Data-Science-/Machine-Learning-Projekten mit und kennen idealerweise den gesamten Lebenszyklus – von Algorithmenentwicklung und statistischer Analyse über Prototyping bis zur **Produktivsetzung und kontinuierlichen Betreuung** von Modellen.
- Sie verfügen über ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis von **Datenanalyse, Machine Learning und den zugrunde liegenden Algorithmen**.
- Sie besitzen ein gutes allgemeines technisches Verständnis und haben Interesse an **optischer Messtechnik, EUV-Technologie und den dabei entstehenden komplexen Daten**.
- Sie verfügen über einen fundierten Hintergrund in der **Softwareentwicklung**, einschließlich objektorientierter Designprinzipien und testgetriebener Entwicklung.
- **Sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse** sowie Erfahrung mit **Git und Azure DevOps** gehören zu Ihrem technischen Werkzeugkasten.
- Sie sind mit **agilen Entwicklungsmethoden** vertraut und arbeiten gerne an der Schnittstelle zwischen Forschung, Algorithmenentwicklung und produktionsnaher Software.
- Sie zeichnen sich durch **Neugier, Eigeninitiative, Selbstorganisation und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität** aus.
- Sie haben Freude daran, sich intensiv in neue technische und wissenschaftliche Fragestellungen einzuarbeiten.
- Sie arbeiten gerne in interdisziplinären Teams und können komplexe technische Sachverhalte **klar und adressatengerecht kommunizieren**.
- Ihre Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind **mindestens auf B2-Niveau**.

### Bereit für den nächsten Schritt?

Wenn Sie **AI, Data Science, Software Engineering und Hightech-Messtechnik** miteinander verbinden möchten und Freude daran haben, aus komplexen Daten intelligente Lösungen zu entwickeln, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung als

**AI & Data Science Engineer – EUV Metrology (m/w/d).**

job_title: Staff Mechanical Design Engineer – Cabin Engineering  (m/w/d) Berlin, Germany
description:
### What to Expect

The Cabin Engineering team leads concept development and launch of nearly all customer-facing areas inside our vehicles including Seats (all rows Structures, Support Systems, Comfort/Mechatronics) and Interiors (Cockpit (Instrument Panel, Door Trim, Console) and Cabin (Overhead Trims, Hard Trims, and Soft Trims)) through a vehicle’s end-of-life.  Our team’s goal is to innovate and engineer a premium Interior System for our vehicles while optimizing our critical attributes like cost, mass, manufacturability, etc. This is a pivotal role to act as liaison between US and Berlin engineering teams to tackle challenging problems together. As part of a global company, you will tackle engineering challenges together with US and CN Cabin teams alongside other cross-functional teams to continuously innovate and launch new products for Europe and other growing markets. 

### What You’ll Do

* Lead a commodity group of the team (Seats, Cabin, or Cockpit) including scope of several subsystems through full engineering development and launch lifecycles, ensuring technical deliverables and timelines are met according to Program Plan of Record scope 
* Support technical development of the team via Technical Design Reviews, engineering training, and mentorship of more junior engineers 
* Design development, validation and manufacturing launch of components balancing inputs and attributes including, but not limited to, Design Studio styling, ergonomics, serviceability, integration packaging with cost, mass, craftsmanship, NVH, automation, etc. This iterative process includes close collaboration with Studio, Purchasing and Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and broader engineering teams through CAD development, CAE loops, RFQ stages, sourcing, part production, launch and build root-causing 
* Utilize and/or create DFSS, DFMEA, DVP&R concepts and processes to produce robust vehicle component designs alongside hands-on prototyping and trials to learn and fail fast. Consider both analytical and physical assessments including dimensional tolerance stack-ups in design as well as to create detailed GD&T drawings and corresponding checking fixtures. Work closely with Validation and Test & Reliability groups. Collaborate efficiently with key external suppliers and to support overall vehicle development milestones, prototype/production build events, and a successful start of production. Work in partnership with suppliers through part design (when applicable), root-cause troubleshooting, manufacturing trials, part and system level validation, etc. to actively understand and contribute to design solutions. 
* Analyze Field Reliability data of current programs to improve Interior Reliability through design/process/manufacturing changes. Release design changes through Tesla’s 3DExperience system to properly document and track part updates, MBOM changes, and PO releases to downstream teams and suppliers 
* Support team growth via hiring at all engineering levels for Cabin Engineering team.

### What You’ll Bring

* Education background in Mechanical Engineering with a minimum of 6-8 years of experience in automotive seats and/or interior component and subsystem engineering. Proficient in English. 
* First principles, physics-based thinker, and problem solver attitude with mental agility to handle problems of varied scope and complexity, and tight timing constraints. Demonstrate engineering technical aptitude, excellent communication, and creativity. 
* In-depth technical understanding of common automotive and new, latest mass manufacturing technologies and the relationship to design feasibility for a variety of processes including stamping, welding, injection molding, thermoforming, and lamination to achieve world-class craftsmanship/ performance targets. 
* Proficiency in 3D modeling utilizing CATIA V5 or V6 is essential within an automotive product development environment. Experience with Change Control and Part Release within 3DExperience platform is a bonus. 
* Strong working knowledge of DFM and DFA, including familiarity with GD&T and dimensional controls

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

job_title: Software Engineer (Founding Team)
description:
**Warum es junini gibt**

Brillen kauft man seit hundert Jahren auf die gleiche Art: einmal viel Geld auf den Tisch legen und dann mehrere Jahre mit dem Ergebnis leben. Das Brillenabo ändert das. KundInnen bekommen die Brillen, die sie wirklich brauchen, flexibel und zu planbaren monatlichen Kosten. In Skandinavien ist das längst normal, dort setzt der Markt über 300 Millionen Euro im Jahr damit um. In Deutschland kann es bisher nur anbieten, wer eine eigene Softwareabteilung hat. Für rund 8.000 Einzeloptiker und die regionalen Ketten ist es damit unerreichbar.

Wir bauen die Lösung, mit der jeder Optiker ein Brillenabo anbieten kann, von der Kette mit 200 Filialen bis zum Einzeloptiker in der Fußgängerzone. Unser Ziel ist die Marktführerschaft für Brillenabos in Europa, in einer Branche, die seit Jahrzehnten kaum Innovation gesehen hat.

**Wo wir stehen**

Die Plattform ist entwickelt, die erste Optikerkette geht im Oktober live. Die Finanzierung steht und erlaubt uns, nachhaltig auf profitables Wachstum zu setzen. Der Schritt in weitere europäische Märkte ist für das nächste Jahr geplant.

### Aufgaben

**Die Rolle**

Du bist der erste Engineer neben unserem CTO. Keine Legacy-Systeme, keine Prozesse, die dich bremsen.

- **Production Readiness:** Gemeinsam mit dem CTO verantwortest Du die Plattform im Live-Betrieb und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter.
- **Produktverantwortung:** Du übernimmst ganze Bereiche der Plattform und entwickelst sie eigenständig weiter.
- **Technische Entscheidungen:** Architektur, Stack, Build und Deploy. Du entscheidest mit.
- **Direkt am Kunden:** Mittelfristig betreust du eigene Optiker und baust auf Basis dessen, was du dort lernst.
- **AI-first Engineering:** Du prägst, wie wir mit KI entwickeln, testen und ausliefern.

**Unser Stack**

Kotlin und Java mit Spring Boot, React mit TypeScript, AWS mit RDS, GitHub Actions, dazu Integrationen für Auth, Payments und die Warenwirtschaft unserer Optiker.

### Qualifikation

**Was du mitbringst**

- **Zwei bis vier Jahre als Software Engineer** mit Schwerpunkt Backend. Idealerweise hast du Erfahrung mit Java/Kotlin und Spring Boot.
- **Cloud:** Du hast Anwendungen nicht nur gebaut, sondern auch deployed und im Betrieb betreut.
- **React:** weit genug, um ein Feature end-to-end zu liefern, statt auf jemanden zu warten.
- **Deutsch:** gut genug für ein Gespräch mit einem Optiker. Perfekt muss es nicht sein, aber du willst früh eigene Kunden betreuen. B2-Niveau oder besser.
- **Umsetzung vor Diskussion:** Du entscheidest lieber und korrigierst später. Mit einer Lösung, die nur okay ist, bist du nicht zufrieden.
- **Low Ego**

### Benefits

**Wie wir arbeiten**

Wir sind ein kleines, motiviertes Team, das schnell skalieren will. Das Arbeitsumfeld ist anspruchsvoll und kann zeitweise intensiv sein. Dafür bekommst Du früh Verantwortung, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und kannst einzigartige Erfahrungen sammeln. Du arbeitest direkt mit Ben (MSc Economics LSE, Software Engineer unter anderem bei SoundCloud) und Constantin (PhD Oxford, BCG, zuletzt VP Strategy bei Mister Spex). Wir arbeiten onsite in Berlin im Büro.

**Was wir bieten**

55.000 bis 70.000 Euro je nach Qualifikation und Erfahrung, je nach Profil und Seniorität zusätzlich eine Beteiligung über unser VSOP-Programm. Dazu 30 Urlaubstage, Apple Hardware, Fitness-Mitgliedschaft und weitere Benefits, und ein Büro in Berlin, in dem wir gemeinsam arbeiten.

**So läuft die Bewerbung**

Bewerbung über JOIN, dazu drei bis vier Sätze, was dich an der Aufgabe reizt als Anschreiben. Rückmeldung innerhalb von 48 Stunden, erstes Gespräch innerhalb einer Woche, danach ein vergüteter Trial Day bei uns im Büro in Berlin und die finale Entscheidung wenige Tage später. Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb Dich trotzdem.

job_title: Lead Mechanical Design Engineer, Power Electronics (m/f/d)
description:
### What to Expect

Please not: roles are open at multiple seniority levels for demonstrated excellence.At Tesla Engineering Germany in Freiburg, we're building the future of sustainable energy by developing innovative power electronics for energy storage and vehicle charging systems. You will own the cradle-to-grave mechanical design of tightly integrated, high-volume electromechanical systems, from first concept through prototyping and validation to mass production. You'll work closely with Electrical, Product, Reliability, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams. This is an opportunity to own key projects, use modern tools, and work in state-of-the-art facilities on power electronics that ship in Tesla products worldwide. Your work contributes directly to the world's transition to sustainable energy. At the lead level, you will also set technical direction and guide a small team of mechanical engineers.

### What You’ll Do

* Own the electromechanical design of injection-molded plastics, sheet metal, high-pressure die castings, heat sinks / cold plates, insulation systems, magnetics, HV/LV interconnects, busbars, and PCBA-adjacent structures
* Solve electronics packaging end-to-end: thermal management, high-voltage insulation (creepage/clearance), IP67+ sealing, EMI, shock/vibration, and long-term environmental reliability
* Lead track: Serve as technical owner of a product line, mentor 3–4+ engineers, lead and approve design reviews, and enforce technical rigor and schedule discipline
* Analyze before you cut metal: thermal / CFD, structural FEA, tolerance stacks, DFM / DFA / DFR, and DFMEA where it matters
* Design custom magnetics and power interfaces (inductors, transformers, chokes, terminals) as first-class mechanical products, not afterthoughts
* Partner with electrical, systems, reliability, manufacturing, supply chain, and compliance teams, and design against UL / IEC / GB standards through to certification
* Drive prototypes into reality: builds, test support, characterization, design verification, and root-cause analysis of failures
* Release for production in CATIA 3DEXPERIENCE: 3D models, 2D drawings with GD&T, PLM / ECOs / BOMs, and supplier collaboration for automated manufacturing at thousands of units per week

### What You’ll Bring

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience; Master’s degree preferred for senior/ staff/ lead level
* Strong mechanical fundamentals and a physics-based, first-principles approach to structural and thermal problems
* Proven product design ownership from concept to scaled production (portfolio preferred)
* Lead track: 7+ years of relevant product design experience, including 2+ years of design leadership
* Fluency in CATIA V5 / 3DEXPERIENCE, GD&T, tolerance analysis, and design for high-volume processes (molding, stamping, die casting, fastening, joining, dispensing)
* Ability to run, or critically review, thermal / CFD / structural analysis, plus working knowledge of power electronics components (PCBAs, MOSFETs, inductors, transformers)
* Detail-oriented, with clear written and verbal communication in English and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment Highly valued:
* Direct experience in power electronics packaging: inverters, chargers, DC-DC, magnetics, busbars, or HV semiconductor modules
* Experience designing against certification standards (UL, IEC, GB) and obtaining certificates
* Multiphysics intuition: heat transfer, fluids, mechanics, and materials (magnetics a strong plus)
* MATLAB / Python for data reduction, scripting, or reduced-order thermal models
* PLM / change control / BOM discipline in a fast-moving product environment
* Hands-on lab instinct: you would rather instrument a prototype than argue from a slide

job_title: System Platform Engineer KI (m/w/d)
description:
**Unternehmensbeschreibung**

Lass uns gemeinsam neue Wege gehen! Denn genau das tun wir bei der R+V, einem der größten Versicherer Deutschlands.

Willkommen im Ressort Operations und IT, in dem die R+V alle kundennahen Operations-Einheiten und die IT bündelt. Ziel ist es, Prozesse und technische Voraussetzungen so zu verbessern, dass die R+V Kundenanliegen schneller, effizienter und digitaler bearbeiten kann. Innovative Techno­logien und unsere vielfältige Systemlandschaft bieten Möglichkeiten für fachliche und persönliche Ent­wicklung.

Für unsere KI-Plattform suchen wir KollegInnen in unterschiedlichen Erfahrungsstufen: Professional, Senior Professional und Principal System Platform Engineer

**Stellenbeschreibung**

- Als Platform Engineer arbeitest Du in Kombination aus Engineering-Methoden und Cloud-Architekturen mit den aktuellen Data- und Analytics-Technologien an der KI-Plattform der R+V.
- In einem Scrum-Team entwickelst Du von der Spezifikation über Design, bis Implementierung unter Betrachtung von Skalierbarkeit und Stabilität unsere KI-Lösung im ganzheitlichen Sinne von DevOps (You build it, you run it) weiter und betreibst diese.
- Du arbeitest intensiv mit CI/CD (GitLab), inkl. Builds, Tests, Security-Scans, Deployments sowie Monitoring.
- Du definierst und setzt Proof of Concepts und Prototypen um.
- Auch Konzeption und Implementierung individueller Lösungen sind Teil Deiner Aufgabe.
- Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung bzw. Scouting von Technologien, Methoden und Tools sowie aktive Wissensvermittlung sind für Dich selbstverständlich.
- Die Vorteile einer engen Zusammenarbeit mit Data Scientists, Data Engineers und Fachbereichen nutzt Du für eine erfolgreiche Lösungsfindung.
- Du nutzt im Betrieb und Troubleshooting Containern Systeme wie Docker und bringst Erfahrung in der netzwerkseitigen Anbindung von Cloud-Umgebungen an Unternehmensnetzwerke mit.
- Du möchtest Dich diesen Herausforderungen stellen, zusammen mit dem Team neue Wege beschreiten, Themen für die R+V vorantreiben und Dich dabei persönlich weiterentwickeln.

**Qualifikationen**

- Erfolgreiches Studium in Naturwissenschaften, Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Interesse daran, Dichin moderne Data- und Cloud Technologien einzuarbeiten, insbesondere im Umfeld von Azure Machine Learning, Public Cloud, Data Factory/ Synapse Pipeline sowie Data Ingestion (ETL/ELT).
- Erfahrung im Erstellen und Debuggen von Docker-Images sowie im Umgang mit Terraform und Python.
- Kenntnisse in Azure-Infrastrukturen und - Services, z.B. VNets, Service und Private Endpoints, Identity Management, RBAC/ACL sowie Azure Storage (insbesondere Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2), sind von Vorteil.
- Erfahrung in der netzwerkseitigen Anbindung von Cloud-Umgebungen an Unternehmensnetzwerke
- Praxiserfahrung im Einsatz von Coding Agents (z.B. Claude Code oder Codex) sowie ein gutes Verständnis für modernes AI-assisted Coding und Vibe Engineering.
- Du bringst eine Kommunikationsstärke, Teamfähigkeit und Freude in der Zusammenarbeit interdisziplinären Teams mit.
- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (mind. Level B2-C1).

**Zusätzliche Informationen**

**Homeoffice:** Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Homeoffice und Büro. Mehr Infos zu unserem hybriden Arbeiten findest Du [hier](https://www.ruv.de/karriere/blog/HomeOffice-bei-ruv).

**Arbeitszeiten:** Standardmäßig 38h-Woche, Zeiterfassungssystem, Gleitzeit & Lebensarbeitszeitkonto.

job_title: AI Engineer (f/m/d)
company_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As an AI Engineer (f/m/d), you will become a valued member of a passionate and highly skilled team. Within our Process Digitalization Department, you will serve as the link between software development, data science, and business functions by integrating trained machine learning models and AI capabilities, including Large Language Models (LLMs), into real-world, scalable, and production-ready software applications.

You will collaborate closely with more than 30 factories across our global manufacturing network, translating business requirements into robust, secure, and future-proof AI-driven software solutions. Utilizing technologies and platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and Snowflake Cortex, you will design and implement end-to-end AI workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions, data pipelines, and model integrations that can be deployed, operated, and scaled across the organization.

Your work will play a key role in modernizing legacy systems, automating data flows, enhancing decision-making processes, and establishing a reliable foundation for data-driven, AI-supported, and sustainable business growth.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

     * Driving AI-enabled modernization initiatives across an international manufacturing network through the application of the company's digitalization methodology, covering core business domains such as production, sales, finance, quality, and procurement
     * Integration of AI and machine learning capabilities into existing IT systems, applications, and user interfaces, ensuring the generation of measurable business value within operational environments
     * Design and implementation of scalable machine learning pipelines, AI workflows, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions based on modern cloud, data, and AI technologies
     * Development of robust architectures for data processing, prompt orchestration, embedding-based search, and AI-powered query chains
     * Continuous evaluation of AI-generated outputs with regard to quality, usability, reliability, and hallucination risk, including the derivation and implementation of measurable improvement measures
     * Ensuring the scalability, maintainability, and production readiness of AI solutions through the application of MLOps principles, automated deployment processes, and established operational standards

What You Bring

     * University degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Data Science, AI Engineering, Software Engineering with professional experience in these fields within cloud-based enterprise environments
     * Strong programming expertise in Python and SQL, including the development of reliable, maintainable, and production-ready software solutions and data-driven applications
     * Practical experience with modern AI and machine learning ecosystems, including frameworks and technologies such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, Azure OpenAI, and comparable platforms
     * Expertise in the design and integration of AI-powered solutions into productive business processes, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embedding technologies, vector search, content safety concepts, and cost-efficient AI implementation
     * Solid knowledge of cloud and data platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure or AWS, as well as experience with vector databases and search technologies such as Azure AI Search or Snowflake Cortex
     * Strong business and stakeholder orientation, including the translation of business requirements into user-centric AI solutions, excellent communication and interpersonal skills, business fluency in German and English, a proactive working style, and willingness to travel internationally

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

     * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
     * We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
     * We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
     * The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
     * In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

  *  30 Tage Urlaub: 6 Wochen freie Zeit, die du zur Erholung, Entspannung, zum Reisen und Füße hochlegen nutzen kannst.
  *  Modern Workplace: Am Arbeitsplatz der Zukunft erhältst du neuestes Technikequipment und arbeitest in einem innovativen Arbeitsumfeld.

  *  Sicherheit: Als zukunftsstarker Arbeitgeber profitierst du von einer sicheren und unbefristeten Anstellung.


Das erwartet dich im Bechtle IT-Systemhaus Bonn/Köln: Wir sind von Client Management über Lösungen von Datacenter und Netzwerke bis hin zu IT-Security und Business Applications breit aufgestellt. Unser Hauptsitz mit circa 700 Kolleginnen und Kollegen befindet sich in Bonn, weitere Niederlassungen in Sankt Augustin, Köln, Koblenz und Mainz. job_title: Research Software Engineer – AI and Earth Observation
description:
# Research Software Engineer – AI and Earth Observation

The  operates one of the most powerful computer systems for scientific and technical applications in Europe and makes it available to scientists at Forschungszentrum Jülich, in Germany and across Europe for research purposes via an independent peer-review process. As part of this remit, the JSC carries out research and development work in the fields of technology, HPC systems, communications, highly scalable data science, mathematics and application support. The  department develops machine learning techniques and other methods and tools for the management, analysis and modelling of large-scale data, and for the integration of data and computing resources into federated HPC infrastructures. The models, tools and methods are developed in collaboration with users in selected scientific domains, tested, scaled for the pre-zettascale era and offered as generic solutions to a large number of scientific communities. Join us now and contribute with your expertise to this interesting field.

## Your Job

In this position, you will join our . The lab advances interdisciplinary research and operational services by combining geoscience and remote sensing methods with AI and advanced computing technologies for Earth observation (EO) applications. Your work will focus on deploying, operating and scaling scientific software, AI services and data workflows across supercomputing, cloud and quantum computing environments. You will work closely with our researchers and international partners from academia, industry and public agencies, bringing together scientific computing, data engineering and AI to address EO challenges.

Specifically, you will:

- Design, deploy and operate end-to-end federated EO and AI workflows, from multisource data collection and pre-processing to model training, serving and delivery of actionable information
- Build and maintain containerised and cluster-based environments for AI services, including deployment pipelines, monitoring, logging and alerting
- Develop, port and optimise scientific software and workflows across HPC, cloud and hybrid quantum-classical environments, ensuring performance, scalability, portability and reliability
- Apply sustainable software engineering and MLOps practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, packaging, versioning and documentation, to support reproducibility and maintainability
- Develop and document stable APIs and accessible interfaces that help users integrate EO and AI services into their operational workflows
- Collaborate with researchers and infrastructure teams to align applications with available computing, storage and networking resources, and support the adoption of HPC and AI services
- Contribute expertise in advanced analytics to research initiatives and the preparation of proposals for national and international funding calls and tenders
- Contribute to open-source projects, technical reports, publications, presentations and educational activities, including courses, hackathons and community events

## Your Profile

Your qualifications and technical background include:

- An excellent master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science or a related field. A subsequent PhD is not required but would be a plus
- At least a few years of industry experience in software engineering, data engineering, scientific computing or AI engineering, with hands-on experience delivering and supporting production software, data-intensive workflows or computing services
- Strong programming skills and practical experience with Linux, containerisation, version control and service deployment on HPC systems or cloud infrastructure, including GPU-accelerated workloads
- Experience with deep learning frameworks, production model serving and end-to-end data and model pipelines, including monitoring, experiment tracking and model lifecycle management
- Evidence of research or software contributions through publications and/or open-source projects
- Self-motivation, autonomy and sound judgement, with the ability to take a system-wide view and adapt to operational challenges
- The ability to collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary, international teams, supported by a very good command of written and spoken English with extensive vocabulary (at least B2 level according to the ), ideally supported by a certificate confirming the language level

## Our Benefits for You

- **Meaningful tasks:** The position offers a varied and diverse role in an international environment
- **Work-life balance:** Optimal conditions for balancing work and private life, as well as a family-friendly company policy. The option of flexible working (in terms of location) is generally available after consultation and in line with upcoming tasks and (on-site) appointments
- **Vacation:** You will receive 30 days of vacation plus additional days off (e.g. between Christmas and New Year's)
- **Flexibility:** Flexible working time models, , allow you to tailor your working hours to suit your individual needs
- **Knowledge & further training:** Your professional development is important to us – we provide targeted, individual support
- **Campus experience:** Our research campus in the countryside creates ideal conditions for collegial exchange and sporting activities right on site. Our cafeteria offers a wide range of options—you can enjoy a relaxing lunch break with a lake view
- **Fair remuneration:** Depending on your existing qualifications and the tasks assigned to you, you will be classified in pay grade 13 of the TVöD-Bund (Collective Agreement for the Public Service). All information on the TVöD-Bund collective agreement can be found on the. The monthly salaries in euros can be found on page 74 of the PDF download
- **Additional benefits:** Benefit from attractive additional services such as a company pension scheme with employer contribution. In addition to the basic salary, there is an additional year-end bonus under the collective pay agreement amounting to 75% of a monthly salary, as well as capital-forming benefits
- **Fixed-term:** The position is initially limited to 2 years
- **Support for international employees:** Our International Advisory Service makes it easier for international employees to get started

In addition to exciting tasks and a collegial working environment, we offer you much more:

We welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds, e.g. in terms of age, gender, disability, sexual orientation / identity, and social, ethnic and religious origin. A diverse and inclusive working environment with equal opportunities in which everyone can realize their potential is important to us.

The following links provide further information on diversity and equal opportunities:  and on specific support options for women:

job_title: Head of Data Analytics & AI
description:
„Sinnvoll für Mensch und Erde“ zu handeln, ist unsere tägliche Motivation. Nicht nur beim Entwickeln und Verkaufen unserer Alnatura Bio-Produkte - auch in der Art und Weise, wie wir bei Alnatura zusammenarbeiten. Unsere Kultur ist auf ganzheitliches Denken, kundenorientiertes Handeln und Selbstverantwortung ausgelegt.

Als Head of Data Analytics & AI entwickelst Du dieses Themenfeld strategisch, organisatorisch und technologisch weiter. Du verbindest unternehmerisches Denken mit einem fundierten Verständnis moderner Datenplattformen und schaffst gemeinsam mit Deinem Team die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass aus Daten nachhaltiger Wert entsteht.

Werde in unserem Bereich IT ein Teil unserer Alnatura Arbeitsgemeinschaft
in Vollzeit (40 Stunden / Woche)

## So kannst Du Dich bei uns einbringen

- Du entwickelst unsere unternehmensweite Data Analytics- und AI-Strategie und überführst sie gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen und der IT in eine wirkungsorientierte Roadmap
- Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Abteilung Data Analytics & AI und entwickelst Dein Team fachlich, organisatorisch und kulturell weiter
- Du gestaltest unsere moderne Datenplattform auf Basis von Microsoft Fabric und sorgst gemeinsam mit Deinem Team für einen skalierbaren, zuverlässigen und wirtschaftlichen Betrieb
- Du entwickelst ein gemeinsames Zielbild für Datenarchitektur, Business Intelligence, Analytics und AI und begleitest wesentliche Architektur- und Technologieentscheidungen
- Du etablierst klare Leitplanken für Data Governance, Datenqualität, Informationssicherheit und Compliance und verankerst diese wirksam in der Organisation

- Du förderst eine datenorientierte Arbeitsweise, stärkst die Data und AI Kompetenz im Unternehmen und machst Fortschritte und Wirkung transparent

## So überzeugst Du uns

- Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Science oder AI und hast bereits ein Team oder einen fachübergreifenden Verantwortungsbereich geführt
- Du verbindest strategisches und unternehmerisches Denken mit einem ausgeprägten technischen Verständnis moderner Cloud Datenplattformen und Datenarchitekturen
- Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Fabric oder vergleichbaren Plattformen mit und verstehst insbesondere das Zusammenspiel von OneLake, Warehouse, Data Factory, Power BI und semantischen Modellen

- Du hast Erfahrung mit Data Governance, Datenqualität, Metadatenmanagement, Informationssicherheit und Compliance. Kenntnisse in SQL, Python, Power BI, Azure und AI Technologien sind von Vorteil
- Du steuerst komplexe Initiativen strukturiert und behältst dabei Geschäftsnutzen, technische Machbarkeit, Kosten, Risiken und Veränderungsbedarf im Blick
- Du schaffst Orientierung, kommunizierst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich und gewinnst unterschiedliche Stakeholder für gemeinsame Ziele
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab

## Unsere Wertschätzung für Deine Mitarbeit

- **Unternehmenskultur:** „Sinnvoll für Mensch und Erde“, kurze Entscheidungswege, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Selbstverantwortung, kollegiale Zusammenarbeit sowie Marktpraktika 
- **Vorteile:** 30 Tage Urlaub, Sonderurlaub, Weihnachts- und Urlaubsgeld, Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Warengutschein für unsere Märkte (nach erfolgreichem Geschäftsjahr), Dienstradleasing, Zuschuss zum Deutschland-Ticket

- **Mobiles Arbeiten**: Vollausgestattete und ergonomische Arbeitsplätze am Alnatura Campus, flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice (maximal 40%)
- **Campus-Leben:** Rabattiertes Mittagessen im vegetarischen Restaurant Vegi – inkl. Sonnenterrasse, grünes Außengelände mit Naturteich, Gemüsegärten und Weinterrassen, kostenlose Getränke wie Wasser, Tee und Kaffee

## Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung

Wir leben Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von sozialer oder ethnischer Herkunft oder Nationalität, Geschlecht und geschlechtlicher Identität, Religion und Weltanschauung, körperlichen und geistigen Fähigkeiten, sexueller Orientierung oder Alter.

job_title: Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer (m/w/d) | Healthcare & Life Science
description:
Limebit ist ein Berliner Beratungsunternehmen für Data Science und Machine Learning im Gesundheitswesen. Seit zehn Jahren arbeiten wir mit Krankenkassen, Klinikgruppen, Forschungseinrichtungen und Pharmaunternehmen daran, aus Medizindaten belastbare Erkenntnisse und produktive Anwendungen zu machen.

**Unser Team aus Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Mathematiker:innen und Softwareentwickler:innen wächst weiter. Wir suchen eine Person mit erster Praxiserfahrung, die mit uns an anspruchsvollen Kundenprojekten arbeitet und sich bei uns fachlich weiterentwickeln will.**

## Aufgaben

* Analysen und ML-Modelle auf echten Versorgungsdaten wie GKV-Abrechnungsdaten, Krankenhausdaten oder Krebsregisterdaten

## Qualifikation

* Abgeschlossenes Studium in Data Science, Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik, Physik, Bioinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Fach, alternativ vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung

**Ein zusätzliches Plus gibt's für:**

* Erfahrung mit Gesundheitsdaten

## Benefits

* Flexibles Arbeiten: 2-3 Tage Home Office pro Woche

* Erfahrenes Management, das jederzeit ansprechbar ist und dir früh Verantwortung überträgt
* Keine unbezahlten Überstunden, Mehrarbeit wird durch Freizeit ausgeglichen
* Edenred-Karte mit monatlichem Budget zur freien Verwendung
* Kostenloses Mittagessen, Getränke und Snacks im Büro
* MacBook als Arbeitsgerät
* 28 Urlaubstage

**Wer ist deine Ansprechpartner:in bei uns?**

Wir sind klein genug, dass du dich in jeder Situation auf Feedback und Unterstützung des ganzen Teams verlassen kannst. [Florian](https://www.linkedin.com/in/florian-richter-limebit/) und [Philipp](https://www.linkedin.com/in/philipp-gro%C3%9Fer/) werden dich einarbeiten, dir ein bisschen was über die Geschichte von Limebit erzählen, dir dein neues MacBook überreichen und dich ganz persönlich willkommen heißen. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf, ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Wir freuen uns über alle Bewerbungen, unabhängig von Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Religion, Alter oder Behinderung.

job_title: Data Governance Specialist Audit & Assurance (f/m/d)
company_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

 

As a Data Governance Specialist with a focus on Data Governance Audit and Assurance, you are part of our growing Data Governance team within our Digital Core function, where we work together on supporting the wider needs and demands from the business, transforming the way we think of data and embedding data management in our key deliveries across all areas of the energy industry. In this fast-paced environment, you will assist your team in the formation and execution of the data governance framework, policy, standards; with particular focus on designing and implementing a modern data governance audit and assurance framework with controls, tools, enablers, and collaboration mechanisms to monitor and assess the data maturity of Siemens Energy domains and support continuous improvement. This role will also contribute to data governance enablement activities to make data accountability real; in this manner you will contribute to the execution of data governance framework, policy, standards. As a valued member of the Data Governance team, you will assist in the operationalisation of our enterprise data governance efforts to truly bring data governance alive at Siemens Energy.

 

 

How You’ll Make an Impact
     * Design and implement a modern data governance audit and assurance framework with controls, tools, enablers and collaboration mechanisms to monitor and assess the data maturity of Siemens Energy domains and support continuous improvement
     * Automate this framework making it user friendly so that it can be understood by our stakeholders and embraced into execution; leveraging our Data Governance tools, such as Data Catalog and Data Quality, and building upon our SE data governance processes  
     * Communicate data governance concepts effectively and facilitate training to enable and operationalize the data management roles in the organization 
     * Design, deliver and execute (baseline) data maturity assessments, along with other data governance controls or mechanisms, ensuring ongoing monitoring, alignment with targets (where applicable) and remediation actions  
     * Create and refine policies, procedures, and guidelines to mature the concept of data governance and the practices around data management across Siemens Energy; and align them where applicable to the audit and assurance framework. 
     * Engage with data stakeholders through the Data Governance forums and regular touch-points to formalize decisions and plans on data governance audit and assurance practices. including data maturity review cycles, gain their buy-in and follow-up on tracking and reporting of maturity improvements and targets
     * Support the development and maintenance of an end-to-end data lifecycle management approach; leverage the Data Management Enterprise Process and Data FAIR process and make sure our framework for data governance audit and assurance builds upon the enterprise data management practices 
     * Collaborate with the wider Data Governance team, Digital Core and the business; for the framework to be a successful collaboration endorsed and adopted by all; reinforcing the team efforts on establishing commons ways of working, adoption of the data governance metamodel, production of reusable governed data products and availability of AI-ready data

What You Bring
     * University degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Information Technologies or a related field. Experience with the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform, Informatica Data Catalog, Collibra Data Quality and Observability platform or similar products. 
     * Extensive proven experience in embedding Data Governance and Data Management in a large organization (preferably), particularly in designing, planning and executing audit and assurance controls in complex environments; therefore, guiding the business through the process, supporting them with recommendations and enabling them to act upon the findings. 
     * Specialist in designing and implementing Data Governance; has experience or very good understanding of Master and Reference Data Management, Data Quality Management, Metadata Management, Enterprise Data architecture and Data security practices. 
     * Proven facilitation skills to drive progress and resolve issues within large data governance programs, with expert understanding of existing data management frameworks, tools and best practices and ability to pragmatically apply these 
     * Strong communication and change management skills: able to explain technical concepts to business colleagues in plain language and naturally incorporate change management activities in the rollout of any data governance capability. Fluent in both written and spoken English 
     * Growth mindset: flexible to multiple, sometimes competing, demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change You are motivated to contribute to the transformation and decarbonization of energy generation globally

About the Team 

The Digital Core organization was created to streamline the lifecycle of software, data, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence solutions for Siemens Energy.  Within Digital Core, our Data Governance team is a center of excellence that enables the organization to discover, access and use harmonized, high quality data in service of the Siemen’s Energy mission. We partner with the business to support them as they build strong foundations using policy, process and technology provided by our team. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.00 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo 

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits
     * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
     * We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
     * We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
     * The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
     * In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

job_title: (Senior) Mechanical Design Engineer – Power Electronics (m/f/d)
description:
### What to Expect

At Tesla Engineering Germany in Freiburg, we’re building the future of sustainable energy by developing innovative power electronics for energy storage and vehicle charging systems. Join our team to collaborate across different engineering areas, solve meaningful challenges creatively and transfer concepts from initial design, through prototyping and testing into real-world solutions.This is an opportunity to own key projects, use modern tools, and work in state-of-the-art facilities to create technologies that shape how energy systems evolve. You get to work on advancing power electronics used for Tesla products globally, thereby directly contributing to the acceleration of the world's transition to sustainable energy. 

### What You’ll Do

* Own electro-mechanical design of plastics, sheet metal, die castings, heat sinks / cold plates, insulation systems, magnetic components, HV connectors, fasteners, busbars, and PCBA-adjacent structures
* Solve electronics packaging end-to-end: thermal management, electrical isolation, sealing, interconnection, shock/vibration/strain, EMI, and RF interfaces
* Analyze before you cut metal: thermal / CFD, structural FEA, tolerance stacks, DFM / DFA / DFR; DFMEA where it matters
* Design custom magnetics and power interfaces (inductors, transformers, filter chokes, terminals) as first-class mechanical products — not afterthoughts
* Partner tightly with electrical, firmware, systems, manufacturing, compliance, and test so mechanical choices enable — not fight — converter performance
* Drive prototypes into reality: builds, fixture/test support, characterization, design verification, root-cause on failures
* Release for production: drawing packages, manufacturing instructions, PLM / ECOs / deviations / BOM structure, supplier and factory collaboration
* Ship globally: designs that land in vehicles, residential/industrial energy products, and charging systems manufactured at scale

### What You’ll Bring

* Bachelor degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience;
* Strong mechanical fundamentals and a first-principles problem-solving style
* Proven product design ownership (from concept to validated hardware to scaled production, or equivalent depth)
* Fluency in 3D CAD (CATIA V5 / 3DEXPERIENCE V6 strongly preferred)
* Working knowledge of GD&T, tolerance analysis, and design for high-volume manufacturing (injection molding, stamping, die casting, fastening, joining, dispensing)
* Ability to run or critically consume thermal / CFD / structural analysis (ANSYS, StarCCM, COMSOL, or equivalent)
* Comfort with PCBAs, basic electrical fundamentals, and collaborating across EE / PE domains Highly valued:

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

  
This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

  
Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

job_title: Data & AI Engineer (all genders), PharmaHera Service GmbH
description: Deine neue Umgebung: Behind PharmaHera is Atida - one of Europe's leading online pharmacy groups, serving over 5 million customers across 9 countries. Together with the CEPD Group, we combine more than 25 years of pharmaceutical expertise with digital excellence to redefine the online pharmacy experience: We are building a trusted, personalized health ecosystem that guides people from prevention to cure - backed by medical expertise and driven by our conviction: Pharmacy is about people. Based in Berlin, we serve as the group's competence center for Germany and the Netherlands. As a specialized partner, we manage e-commerce, marketing, IT, and logistics for our local mail-order pharmacies, such as APONEO. Our European markets run on a single, standardized data platform (our Foundation layer). Your mission for the future: To transform this data infrastructure so it is not only usable by people, but specifically prepared for AI agents that read, analyze, and autonomously act on it. The role Reporting to the Data & AI Engineer Lead, you will own the data pipelines, datasets, AI agents and tools built on top of Foundation, and you will build most of them with AI agents as part of your toolchain. The role sits one level of abstraction above the code: you specify, review and take responsibility for systems rather than typing every line. Core responsibilities Pipeline development: build and optimize data flows in Apache Airflow, from our European markets into BigQuery. Modeling in BigQuery: implement tables and views in the Foundation layer, guaranteeing KPI comparability across Spain, France, Italy and Germany. Semantic layer and data contracts: keep business definitions consistent across dashboards, models and agents, and define the schema, granularity and quality a dataset guarantees. AI-assisted delivery: use Claude Code and the Anthropic API as your everyday engineering environment -- turn a requirement into a precise specification, let the agent produce the pipeline, then review, test and own the result. Building for agents: expose Foundation through MCP tools and skills so that AIDA and our decision agents can query it reliably. A dataset is finished when an agent can use it without being misled. Evaluation: build the evals, checks and monitoring that tell us whether an agent's output is correct. Unit tests are not enough for non-deterministic systems. Data products: design data products for management, finance, commercial, operations and marketing -- reusable across markets. Visualization and reporting: work with the business team on reports and consumable datasets in Apache Superset. Code and traceability: clean Python and SQL, with every task traceable through our GitLab-Coda integration. Agent-generated code included. Your Profile & Tech Stack What You Bring to the Role (Must-Haves): Education & Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering or Data Science. AI-Assisted Engineering: Regular, demonstrable use of an LLM coding agent (Claude Code or equivalent) in daily work, plus the technical judgment to critically review agent-generated code. Tech Stack & Cloud: Solid experience with Google Cloud Platform (especially BigQuery), Apache Airflow, strong SQL, data-oriented Python, and version control via Git/GitLab. Languages: Fluent English for daily collaboration within our international team. Mindset & Work Ethic: Strong analytical skills, an independent and results-focused approach ("you get the problem and context, the solution design is yours to propose"), and a commitment to deeply understanding code rather than using AI as a blind shortcut. What Rounds Off Your Profile (Nice-to-Haves): Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), LLM APIs, ClearML, Docker, or Apache Druid. Know-how in evaluating non-deterministic systems and using BI tools (ideally Apache Superset). Industry experience in the healthcare, pharmacy, or e-commerce sectors, plus basic knowledge of German. What we are not looking for Someone who ships code they cannot explain. Someone who needs a ticket with the solution already inside it or with full requirements in place. We act fast: you get the problem, the context and access -- the design is yours to propose. Someone who uses AI as a shortcut and doesn't understand the problem they are solving. Someone who only thinks short-term. We build future-proof solutions. What You'll Get Your Work Environment: Freedom to Shape Your Role from Day 1: A position of responsibility with real opportunities for growth, where you can proactively drive initiatives and actively help shape strategies. Permanent, Full-Time Position: Long-term prospects in a future-proof market. Agile Work Environment: A motivated, dynamic team and flat hierarchies with short decision-making paths that enable fast execution. Flexibility with Team Spirit: Flexible working hours and a hybrid work model (mobile work & in-office) - with a focus on our Berlin office to foster collaboration and team cohesion. Direct Mentoring: Close collaboration and mentoring by the Data & AI Engineer Lead in a technically demanding environment. Hands-on Production Tech Stack: Real-world experience with Airflow, BigQuery, Druid, GCP, and a modern production AI stack (Claude, MCP, Agents, Evals). Professional AI Tooling: First-class AI engineering tools come as standard equipment. Your Benefits at a Glance: Health & Mobility: Urban Sports Club membership at an unbeatable price and a heavily discounted BVG corporate transit pass for your daily commute. Exclusive Perks: Attractive employee discounts on our entire APONEO product range, access to a wide variety of corporate benefits, and a Selgros card. All-Round Care: An on-campus cafeteria, free fresh fruit, vegetables, and snacks every day, plus an unlimited coffee and tea flat rate. Your Compensation & Terms: For this full-time, permanent position, we offer an attractive, market-based, and competitive compensation package. We anticipate an annual gross salary between EUR45,000 and EUR55,000 p.a. Together, we will determine your exact positioning within this range through a transparent process based on the following criteria: Your relevant practical work experience in Data & AI Engineering. Your professional qualifications and specific additional skills. Our internal salary structure to ensure fairness within the team. Equal Opportunity & Fair Pay: We don't leave fair pay to chance. We compensate all team members in equivalent positions transparently and fairly, regardless of gender or any other personal characteristic. Ready to join? Ready to actively shape the future of e-commerce and data-driven healthcare at Atida? Apply now! We look forward to receiving your CV and your earliest possible starting date.

job_title: Municipal Data Mining & OParl Specialist (m/f/d)
description:
Municipal Data Mining & OParl Specialist (m/f/d) 

Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available)  

Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent)  

Target Group: Software Engineers, NLP Specialists, Data Miners, Opportunity Card Holders, and Master's Graduates  

About Project IRIS Project IRIS is an applied research initiative capturing and analyzing large volumes of public, unstructured text data from municipal information systems. By tracking local planning decisions before they hit official cadastral portals, we create early-warning systems for infrastructure development. In this role, you will build the automated agents that read and understand municipal government data. 

Your Focus & Responsibilities 

- API Integration: Develop and maintain Python-based interfaces to autonomously query municipal council information systems, primarily using the open OParl standard. 
- Document Parsing: Parse and structure extensive text documents, meeting minutes, and official zoning announcements (PDFs, HTML). 
- Text Mining & NLP: Apply regex, text mining, and fundamental NLP techniques to categorize administrative texts and extract spatial entities. 
- Data Harmonization: Clean and transfer the extracted, geocoded data into our central relational database architecture (PostgreSQL/PostGIS). 

What We Are Looking For 

- Technical Background: Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical industry experience.  
- Core Technical Skills: Solid practical experience in Python, data extraction, API handling, and unstructured format processing (PDF, OCR, JSON). Familiarity with OParl is a strong advantage. 
- Mindset: A proactive problem-solving attitude with an eye for extracting structured truth from bureaucratic texts.  
- Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates (Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card supported).  
- Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); fluent or highly proficient German language skills are strictly required to accurately parse and interpret German administrative and legal texts. 

What We Offer 

- Full-Time Permanent Employment: Long-term career stability with clear growth trajectories.  
- Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: Tailored tracks including academic coordination and complete tuition support.  
- Accommodation & Onboarding Package: Structured assistance with local accommodation, official registration, and comprehensive onboarding.  
- Visa & Administrative Backing: Dedicated employer support for Opportunity Card conversions and visa applications.  
- Direct Mentorship: Close collaboration with experienced technical architects and executive leadership.

jobs-scraping@iris-institut.org (Subject: Application - Municipal Data Mining)

job_title: Director Market Intelligence & Data Analytics (m/f/d)

At the intersection of business strategy, market intelligence and data analytics, you will establish trusted analytical standards, turn complex data into insights and enable data-based decision-making across business segments.

- Lead the development and governance of global market models, establishing a single source of truth and driving its compliant use across markets and business areas.
- Establish market definitions, segmentation logic and analytical methodologies in alignment with senior stakeholders across business units, regions and corporate functions.
