Durch enge Kooperationen mit Wissenschaft und Forschung entwickeln wir kontinuierlich neue Ansätze, um Informationsmanagement und Geschäftsprozesse auf ein neues technologisches Niveau zu heben.

## Dein Mission

Du erklärst komplexe Zusammenhänge so, dass dein Gegenüber nicht glasige Augen bekommt, sondern anfängt mitzudenken. Und wenn alle sagen „Läuft doch”, bist du die Person, die freundlich lächelt und fragt: „Aber warum eigentlich?”

Du willst nicht einfach hinnehmen, dass dein EDR einen Kerneltreiber braucht – du willst verstehen, warum. Du weißt, dass „Wir haben doch eine Firewall” ungefähr so beruhigend klingt wie „Das Schiff ist unsinkbar” – und kannst zeigen, wie Daten trotzdem den Weg nach draußen finden.

Nmap, Burp, Responder, Bloodhound – klar, die kennst du. Aber richtig hellhörig werden wir, wenn du deinen Werkzeugkasten um eigene Tools erweitert hast. Weil das fertige Skript halt doch nicht genau das tat, was du wolltest. Weil du es besser konntest. Oder einfach, weil Samstagnacht noch lang war.

Du kommst nicht, um einen Report abzuladen – du kommst, um zu verstehen, wo es wirklich wehtut, und gemeinsam mit dem Kunden (egal ob intern oder extern) Lösungen zu bauen, die über den nächsten Audit hinaus halten.

Dabei wirst du zum Sparringspartner auf Augenhöhe: Du hörst zu, denkst mit und machst Security greifbar – ohne Panikmache. Ob du dabei Angriffe simulierst, Prozesse absicherst oder Teams befähigst, hängt vom Kunden ab – Hauptsache, du hinterlässt ihn stärker, als du ihn vorgefunden hast.

## Dein Alltag

Vergiss das Bild vom einsamen Hoodie-Träger im abgedunkelten Keller. Bei uns ist Cyber Security Teamsport – nur mit besseren Insiderwitzen.

\*\*Humor ist Pflicht, nicht optional.\*\* Wer den ganzen Tag Schwachstellen jagt, Incidents zerlegt und Entwicklern erklärt, warum –privileged kein Lifestyle-Feature ist, braucht eins: Leute um sich, mit denen man darüber lachen kann. 

\*\*Echte Gemeinschaft statt Org-Chart-Kosmetik.\*\* Wir sind kein Team, weil es auf einer Folie steht. Wir sind eins, weil wir uns gegenseitig den Rücken freihalten. Hier kennt jeder jeden, Ego bleibt an der Tür und Wissen wird geteilt, nicht gehortet.

\*\*Motivation, die nicht von Motivationspostern kommt.\*\* Wir sind angetrieben von echter Neugier, nicht von Buzzword-Bingo. Neue Angriffsvektoren, ein cleverer Exploit, ein Tool, das noch keiner auf dem Schirm hatte – das ist es, was uns morgens den Laptop aufklappen lässt. Freiwillig. Vor dem ersten Kaffee (na gut, meistens nach dem ersten Kaffee).

## Deine Aufgaben

Kein Tag wie der andere – und kein Profil wie das andere. Unser Security-Spektrum ist breit, und genau das ist der Punkt: Du musst nicht alles können, aber du solltest Lust haben, dich in mehr als einer Ecke davon zu bewegen. Was genau dein Schwerpunkt wird, entscheiden wir gemeinsam – basierend auf dem, was du mitbringst, was du lernen willst und wo wir dich gerade am meisten brauchen.

## Das Spielfeld:

- **Threat Hunting & Monitoring** – Du spürst Anomalien auf, die anderen nicht auffallen, und sorgst dafür, dass unser Lagebild kein Standbild ist.
- **Interne Pentests** – Du denkst wie ein Angreifer, handelst wie ein Verbündeter – und hilfst uns, Lücken zu schließen, bevor sie welche werden.
- **OSINT & Threat Intelligence** – Du weißt, was über uns da draußen kursiert – im offenen Netz und in den Ecken, die kein Suchergebnis erreicht.
- **Security-Konzepte** – Gemeinsam mit Entwicklern, DevOps, NetOps und Co. baust du Sicherheit in Architekturen ein, statt sie hinterher dranzukleben.
- **Firewall- & AD-Audits** – Du prüfst, ob das, was stehen soll, auch wirklich steht – und räumst auf, wo es nötig ist.
- **Hardening** – Du machst unsere Infrastruktur widerstandsfähiger, Schritt für Schritt, ohne den Betrieb dabei lahmzulegen.
- **Workshops & Wissenstransfer** – Du gibst dein Wissen weiter – ob als Security-Workshop für Kollegen, interner Blogartikel oder spontane Erklärung am Whiteboard.

Und was heute noch nicht auf dieser Liste steht, kann morgen schon dazugehören. Wir bilden uns ständig weiter, evaluieren neue Technologien und passen unseren Aufgabenbereich an das an, was die Bedrohungslage verlangt – nicht an das, was letztes Jahr im Konzept stand. Stillstand ist bei uns kein Feature, sondern ein Finding.

\*\*Der Deal:\*\* Du sagst uns, wo du stark bist und wo du hinwillst. Wir sagen dir, wo wir Bedarf haben. Und dann finden wir die Schnittmenge, die für beide Seiten funktioniert – kein starres Rollenprofil, sondern ein Aufgabenmix, der mit dir wächst.

## Was wir dir bieten:

### Wachstum & Verantwortung

- Langfristige Perspektiven für deine Karriere – keine Sackgasse, sondern echte Entwicklung.
- Die Chance, Zukunft mitzugestalten, spannende Aufgaben zu übernehmen und Verantwortung zu tragen, die auch so heißen darf.
- Umfangreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – Konferenzen, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und die Art von Lernen, die in keinem Kurs steht.

### Kultur & Miteinander

- Eine offene Unternehmenskultur mit unkomplizierter Zusammenarbeit und „Du” auf allen Ebenen – vom Praktikanten bis zur Geschäftsführung.
- Echtes Sparring – ein Team, das dich fordert, nicht nur nickt. Deine Ideen werden besser, weil wir sie hinterfragen. 
- Regelmäßige Teamevents, Sommerfeste und Weihnachtsfeiern.

### Work-Life-Balance & Flexibilität

- Attraktives Arbeitszeitmodell mit Kernarbeitszeiten und hybriden Arbeitsoptionen – weil gute Security-Arbeit nicht an einen Bürostuhl gebunden ist.
- 30 Tage Urlaub – auch Firewalls brauchen Wartungsfenster.

### Vergütung & Vorsorge

- Attraktive, leistungsbezogene Vergütung – dein Impact spiegelt sich wider.

### Arbeitsplatz & Extras

- Fundierte Triage und risikobasierte Entscheidungen sind genau dein Ding.

### Nice to Have

## Deine Perspektiven bei CID …

… sind das, was Du aus ihnen machst. Wenn Du etwas bewegen willst, können wir Dir helfen. CID bietet Dir Chancen, Erfahrung und Wachstum in einem stabilen und sich ständig weiterentwickelnden Unternehmen. job_title: Failure Analysis Engineer, Electrical (m/w/d) Berlin, Germany
description:
### What to Expect

We are looking for a Failure Analysis Engineer, Electrical, to join the failure analysis team in Berlin (Tesla Engineering Germany). This is an individual contributor role. You report to the mechanical failure analysis lead. The team finds root cause and contributing factors, so Tesla can reduce field, production, and development issues. You work with design, manufacturing, quality, and other engineering teams, across vehicle and energy products, including current models and products still in development. We need an electrical engineer with industry experience, not a new graduate, to identify and characterize electrical failures. You use a multimeter, an oscilloscope, and other basic electrical test equipment to confirm the symptom, isolate the fault, and support root cause with Design, Manufacturing, and Quality. The right person is comfortable on the bench: probing boards, reading a schematic well enough to troubleshoot, and explaining what they found. Manufacturing experience is a strong plus. That includes production test, yield, process, or factory debug.?

### What You’ll Do

* Debug and troubleshoot analog and digital systems with a digital multimeter, oscilloscope, power supply, and related bench equipment. 
* Confirm and recreate failures seen in engineering, production, and the field. 
* Drive root cause from the first report toward a countermeasure, with the original design engineers and the other failure analysis engineers. 
* Use the analytical tools the case needs, including functional test, electrical debug, and X-ray. 
* Design experiments to test a theory, and run them yourself or with the technician. 
* Document findings and investigation status. Report root cause and the relevant facts to engineering and manufacturing. 
* Bring prior failure experience into design reviews and DFMEAs. 
* Partner with manufacturing on production and yield-related electrical issues that come into the lab.?

### What You’ll Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
* 1-3 years of industry experience in electrical debug, test, manufacturing, or a related hands-on role. This is not a new-graduate role. Internships and coursework alone are not enough. 
* Hands-on use of a digital multimeter and an oscilloscope, and experience with power supplies and other common electrical test equipment. 
* Able to read a schematic and troubleshoot analog and digital circuitry at a basic to intermediate level. 
* Strong written and spoken English. 
* Self-driven, structured, and comfortable in a fast-paced lab. 
* Preferred: experience with common failure analysis techniques. 
* Preferred: manufacturing experience (production test, yield debug, process engineering, or factory electrical troubleshooting). 
* Preferred: soldering and rework on PCBAs. 
* Preferred: familiarity with common digital protocols (I2C, CAN, LIN).?

job_title: Senior Radar Firmware Engineer
description:
## Role Overview

As our Senior Radar Firmware Engineer, you own the firmware that runs the radar signal chain on our sensor nodes. You implement waveform control and signal processing algorithms bare metal on an NXP radar SoC driving our 77 GHz front end, verify them against measurements in the lab, and keep the chain inside its timing, memory, and power budget. You work directly with the Radar Systems Architect on algorithm design, with the embedded Linux team on the platform your firmware runs on, and with the perception team on the micro-Doppler data their classification models consume.

## Key Responsibilities

- Implement radar signal processing algorithms bare metal on the DSP cores of our NXP radar SoC
- Define and maintain the firmware architecture for the radar signal chain
- Implement waveform generation, timing, and control for the 77 GHz front end
- Verify algorithm behaviour against lab measurements, including the test setups needed to characterize it
- Analyze and optimize runtime, memory, and power consumption on the target hardware
- Produce and maintain the micro-Doppler data products the perception team's classification models are trained and run on
- Work with the Radar Systems Architect to bring algorithm designs onto the target
- Work with the embedded Linux team on interfaces, build integration, and firmware updates

## Required Qualifications

- 7+ years of hands-on firmware or DSP development for embedded signal processing systems (a degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related field is welcome, though equivalent practical experience counts just as much)
- Practical experience with radar signal processing algorithms such as detection, tracking, or clutter suppression
- Experience planning and running radar measurements, and comparing the results against expected algorithm behaviour
- Experience with bare-metal development on multicore SoCs: startup and memory layout, DMA, and interrupt latency
- Solid C skills, plus working proficiency in at least one of C++, Rust, or DSP assembly
- Experience defining firmware architecture for a shipped product, not only for prototypes
- Experience with software and hardware performance analysis: profiling, timing, memory, and power on the target

## Nice to Have

- Experience with FMCW radar and multi-channel or MIMO front ends
- Experience with fixed-point implementation and numerical accuracy analysis
- Experience with vendor DSP toolchains and SDKs, ideally the NXP radar SDK
- Practical command of laboratory instruments such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and vector network analyzers
- Contributions to open-source signal processing or embedded projects
- German language skills are beneficial but not required

job_title: Engineer for Aerodynamics (d/f/m)
description:
#### About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.

#### Job description

In order to support the flight physics department, Airbus Operations in Bremen is looking for several

# **Engineer for Aerodynamics (d/f/m)** 

Are you interested in understanding the physics of flight?

Are you thrilled to shape the next generation of aircraft products and digital services?

Would you like to drive aerodynamic design and characterisation?

Do you embrace diversity and enjoy empowerment?

**Then join us in Aerodynamics!**

There has never been a more exciting time to join commercial aircraft at Airbus. The future is changing and we are working on innovative aircraft technologies, configurations and propulsion systems to meet those ambitions.

  
Within the Airbus Flight Physics transnational centre, the successful applicant will join our Aircraft Aerodynamics team based in Bremen, Germany.

  
The team is responsible for the aerodynamic characterization of the overall aircraft for all Airbus programmes. We generate models representing aerodynamics for customers in aircraft loads, aircraft performance and handling qualities. In that we contribute to the design, optimisation and validation of external aircraft shapes, structure and systems.  
We engage from the early design stage, update and validate design and data through numerical simulation, wind-tunnel testing and flight-test.

  
The challenge of more sustainable aviation requires us to evolve our aerodynamic design and characterization. It can only be tackled in new ways of working, with new digital capabilities and with your curiosity, openness and imagination! This, and a high degree of reliability mixed with an agile mindset are key to achieving our ambitious goals. Strong technical expertise and a rigorous application of safety-relevant processes are fundamental prerequisites.

# **Your location**

Bremen is a charming city full of history in the northwest of Germany. In addition to being one of the country’s greenest cities, it offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. It’s also a great place for seaside lovers, being located just an hour’s drive from the North Sea coast.

# **Your benefits**

- Attractive salary and special payments
- 30 days holidays and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, transportation subsidy, employee benefits at cooperating companies
- On-site-facilities: Kindergarten close to the site, medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria

# **Your tasks and responsibilities**

- Deliver aerodynamic models and data for loads assessment, aircraft performance and handling qualities
- In that contribute to design, optimisation and validation of external aircraft shapes, structure and systems
- Contribute to and define future aerodynamic processes and technologies to keep Airbus at the forefront of innovation
- Collaborate across transnational project teams and disciplines to secure multi-disciplinary design solutions, meeting customer requirements while delivering on time, cost and quality
- Apply data science methods to solve aerodynamic business tasks (application of data analytics, machine learning/artificial intelligence and model based system engineering)
- Provide aerodynamic support to manufacturing plants and airlines

# **Your boarding pass**

- Master degree in Engineering/Aerospace Engineering, Physics or equivalent
- Sound understanding of aerodynamics
- First experience in aerodynamic numerical simulations/Computational Fluid Dynamics, wind tunnel test or flight test
- Expertise in digitalization topics e.g. data fusion, surrogate modeling, model-based system engineering, big data analytics, machine learning and cloud computing
- Good working knowledge of a programming language (preferably Matlab, Python)
- Knowledge of CFD (CAD, meshing, turbulence models, limitations) would be an advantage
- Familiarity with data science (machine learning and artificial intelligence)
- Aptitude for complex problem solving and innovation combined with excellent communication and strong presentation skills
- Team oriented empowered mindset with strong customer focus
- Negotiation level in English and basic language skills in German

This role will involve some travel for business worldwide and as such you must be able to travel accordingly.

This position will require a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

If possible, please submit your CV in English and German.

**Take your career to a new level and apply now!**

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.  
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

job_title: Manufacturing Vision Engineer, Battery Vision (m/w/d)
description:
### What to Expect

Tesla’s Battery Manufacturing team is seeking a Manufacturing Vision Engineer to design and scale advanced inspection and control systems for next-generation battery products. You’ll work on automation processes that directly improve battery performance, quality, and cost, collaborating with world-class engineers in a fast-paced, hands-on environment. This position will help drive technological advancement in this area as part of a small, specialized team. Battery development is at the heart of Tesla, and this is an exciting opportunity to work directly on the central challenges with electric vehicles – battery cost and performance. Tesla is a demanding and fast-paced environment where you will work with a highly motivated team on extremely challenging projects.

### What You’ll Do

* Develop and deploy 2D/3D vision and measurement systems from proof-of-concept to deployment on high-volume battery manufacturing lines
* Guide cross-functional selection of optimal measurement or detection strategy and provide vision interface Design for Manufacturability (DFM) input to product designers
* Collaborate with Manufacturing Design, Controls, Quality and Equipment teams to define optimal inspection strategies, DFM and PFMEA feedback
* Lead proof-of-concept and prototype validation for new vision technologies (Keyence, Cognex, Halcon, OpenCV, etc.)
* Drive process optimization through data analysis, repeatability testing, and equipment validation
* Establish standard methods, libraries, and best practices for machine vision applications across factories
* Occasional domestic and international travel to Tesla factories and supplier sites

### What You’ll Bring

* 3+ years of experience in automation, machine vision, or metrology (manufacturing environment preferred)
* Hands-on experience developing and validating 2D/3D vision applications (Cognex, Keyence, Halcon, OpenCV, etc.)
* Demonstrated experience in the development and implementation of high-volume 2D and 3D machine vision (Keyence, Cognex, Halcon, other) – application design, programming, validation, and troubleshooting
* Experience with one or more additional measurement and inspection technologies: (optical sensors, diodes, profilometry, laser measurement, optical scanning, optical metrology, LVDT, CMM, thermal imaging, ultrasonic measurement, X-ray, other)
* Programming experience with one of more common languages (Python, C#, C++, other)
* Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Mechatronics, or equivalent experience
* Bonus: Experience with data analysis, image processing, or industrial communication protocols

job_title: Mathematisch-technischen Software Engineer
description:
🚀 **Mathematisch-technischer Software Engineer (m/w/d)**
**Automation · Scientific Software · Measurement Systems**

📍 Paderborn · garage33
💰 **3.000 € brutto/Monat**
🕒 Vollzeit
📅 **Start: ab sofort**

## Über EASY Photonics

EASY Photonics ist ein junges Deep-Tech-Startup aus Paderborn.

Wir entwickeln ein kompaktes Multisensorsystem für die automatisierte Analyse von Flüssigkeiten – zunächst für Wasser- und Umweltanwendungen. Unser Ziel ist, komplexe Messungen stärker zu automatisieren und direkt dort verfügbar zu machen, wo die Proben entstehen, z. B. in Kläranlagen, industriellen Prozessen oder wissenschaftlichen Messkampagnen.

Aktuell überführen wir unseren Forschungsdemonstrator in ein robustes, reproduzierbar herstellbares Produkt und bauen gleichzeitig Geräte-, Mess- und Laborautomation auf.

Dafür suchen wir einen **Mathematisch-technischen Software Engineer (m/w/d)**.

## Deine Rolle

Du entwickelst Software dort, wo sie auf reale Hardware trifft.

Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf **Automation und produktnaher Software**:

- Steuerung kartesischer Robotersysteme
- automatisierte Probenvorbereitung und Pipettierung
- Ansteuerung von Motoren, Pumpen, Ventilen und Sensoren
- automatisierte Messabläufe
- Kommunikation zwischen Messgeräten und Automation
- Ablauf- und Zustandssteuerungen
- Fehlererkennung, Logging und Diagnose
- Prüf- und Kalibrierabläufe
- Geräte- und Konfigurationsmanagement
- strukturierte Speicherung und Zuordnung von Messdaten
- Benutzeroberflächen und Schnittstellen

Je nach Projekt und Interesse können auch **Scientific Data Visualization, Dashboards oder georeferenzierte Messdaten** Teil deiner Arbeit werden. Der Schwerpunkt bleibt aber klar auf Softwareentwicklung und Automation.

## Du bist nicht unser „einziger Entwickler“

Wir bauen gerade ein wachsendes technisches Team auf.

Du arbeitest eng zusammen mit:

- einem weiteren **Software Engineer**, der insbesondere an KI-gestützter Auswertung und Datenfusion arbeitet
- einem **Product & Automation Design Engineer**, der die mechanische Seite unserer Geräte, Robotik und Automation entwickelt
- unserem Gründer und der technischen Systementwicklung

Zusätzlich erhalten wir Entwicklungsunterstützung durch **Innowise** sowie das **Jülich Supercomputing Centre (JSC)**.

Du musst also nicht gleichzeitig Embedded Developer, Frontend-Entwickler, KI-Spezialist, Data Scientist und Maschinenbauer sein.

## Wie wir Automation entwickeln

Wir wollen nicht für jedes Problem eine teure fertige Industrieanlage einkaufen.

Viele Systeme entwickeln wir selbst – unter anderem mit kartesischen Achssystemen auf Basis moderner 3D-Drucker-Mechanik, Standardmotoren, Sensoren, Kameras und eigener Hardware.

Der Maschinenkonstrukteur entwickelt beispielsweise die Mechanik eines Pipettierroboters – du entwickelst die Software, mit der daraus ein funktionierendes Automatisierungssystem wird.

## Was du mitbringen solltest

Für die Einstufung im öffentlich geförderten Projekt benötigen wir einen **abgeschlossenen Master- oder Diplomabschluss**, z. B. in:

- Informatik
- Technischer Informatik
- Software Engineering
- Scientific Computing
- Mathematik mit Informatikschwerpunkt
- Computational Science
- Embedded Systems
- Automatisierungstechnik mit starkem Softwareanteil
- oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

Du solltest:

- sehr gut programmieren können
- analytisch und strukturiert denken
- Interesse an mathematisch-technischen Problemen haben
- keine Scheu vor realer Hardware haben
- dich selbstständig in neue technische Systeme einarbeiten können
- auch mit noch nicht vollständig definierten Anforderungen umgehen können

**Berufserfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.**

Eigene Projekte, wissenschaftliche Software, Robotik, Embedded-Systeme, Open-Source-Beiträge oder eine technisch interessante Masterarbeit sind für uns besonders interessant.

Technologien können z. B. Python, C/C++, C#, Rust, Git, Linux, Mikrocontroller, Gerätekommunikation, Datenbanken oder Computer Vision umfassen. Du musst nicht alles davon beherrschen.

## Wie wir arbeiten

Eine typische Aufgabe könnte lauten:

**„Unser Pipettierroboter soll diese Proben automatisch vorbereiten und anschließend die Messung starten.“**

Dann konkretisieren wir gemeinsam die Anforderungen und setzen die Lösung praktisch um:

**programmieren → an echter Hardware testen → Fehler finden → verbessern → erneut testen**

Wenn dir diese Art von Softwareentwicklung Spaß macht, passt die Stelle gut zu dir.

## Dein Arbeitsplatz

Wir arbeiten in der **garage33 in Paderborn**. Dort haben wir umfangreiche Möglichkeiten für Prototyping und Fertigung und bauen einen großen Teil unserer Messgeräte und Automation direkt vor Ort auf.

Softwareentwicklung findet bei uns deshalb nicht losgelöst von der Hardware statt.

## Was wir bieten

- **3.000 € brutto pro Monat**
- Vollzeit, Start ab sofort
- Arbeit in einem wachsenden Deep-Tech-Team
- viel technischer Gestaltungsspielraum
- direkter Kontakt zu Robotik und wissenschaftlicher Messtechnik
- kurze Entscheidungswege
- eigene technische Verantwortung
- Möglichkeit, unsere Software- und Automatisierungsarchitektur früh mitzuprägen
- Entwicklungsumgebung in der garage33
- Finanzierung der Stelle im Rahmen von **Grüne Gründungen.NRW**

## Interesse?

Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und gerne Beispiele deiner bisherigen Projekte, z. B. GitHub, wissenschaftliche Software, Robotikprojekte oder deine Masterarbeit.

Wir suchen nicht den längsten Lebenslauf, sondern jemanden, der **sehr gut denken und programmieren kann und Lust hat, gemeinsam mit einem technischen Team reale Maschinen und wissenschaftliche Messgeräte zu entwickeln.**

job_title: Logistics Systems Engineer (d/f/m)
description:
#### Job description

In order to support the Logistic ELT2 Team, Airbus Helicopters is looking for a

**Logistics Systems Engineer (d/f/m)**

**Your location**

At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.

**Our Benefits for You**

- **Fair Compensation & Extras:** Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- **Time for You (and Your Loved Ones):** 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- **Growth Made Easy:** Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- **Feel Good at Work:** On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- **Diversity Connects:** Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

**Your tasks and responsibilities**

The team of Logistic Systems at Airbus Helicopters is responsible for specifying, implementing and improving the logistics system (warehouse, infrastructure, IT, material allocations, material flows, and processes) to enable Operations (industrial, services, and MRO) for an efficient and reliable On-Time-Delivery of material to the Point of Use/Delivery.  
As a Logistic System engineer, you will contribute to the mission by specifying and designing layouts, flows, processes as well as identifying, analysing, and implementing improvements within warehouse and shopfloor logistics operations. You will leverage operational insights, audits, and data to optimise internal flows, standardise work practices, and enhance process robustness across Airbus Helicopters sites.

- Designing logistic (intra and inter-site) process and infrastructure solutions to enhance efficiency and accuracy
- Designing warehouse layouts and specify infrastructure/means to ensure optimal flows and surface utilization
- Specifying in collaboration with the internal customers logistics means to ensure safe and efficient handling of material
- Support the creation and update of logistics work instructions, ensuring clarity, consistency, and operational applicability
- Ensure a smooth handover to production of the solutions designed by involving operations at an early stage
- Ensuring all logistics solutions are in line with the company's strategic, compliance and environmental policies
- Ensuring all processes are in line with the guidelines provided by quality, export control, and other relevant functions
- Identifying the need for changes in the existing logistic infrastructure and initiate appropriate actions
- Monitor intra-site and inter-site process execution, identifying inconsistencies and contributing to corrective action plans
- Supporting the digitalisation team
- Analyse shopfloor logistics flows, including inbounding, picking, kitting, and outbound, to identify improvement levers
- Provide functional support to site leads and warehouse teams, helping deploy and stabilise improved internal logistics processes at site level

**Desired skills and qualifications**

- Degree in logistics or a related technical field
- At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in the logistics sector (engineering, field service, logistics platforms)
- In-depth knowledge of process design, process optimization, and the implementation of new processes
- Experience with SAP systems (ideally the EWM warehouse management system)
- ​Knowledge of the aerospace industry is a plus
- Basic knowledge of quality management is desirable
- Ability and willingness to navigate a complex corporate environment
- Business-level proficiency in German and English required; knowledge of French is a plus

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

**Take your career to a new level and apply** [**online**](https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) **now!**

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.  
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Sie möchten Ihre Kenntnisse im Java-Umfeld für unsere Cloud Services, zusammen mit unseren Expert:innen einbringen und ein Teil des Software Entwicklungsteams werden? Sie möchten perspektivisch eigenverantwortlich Technologie-Stacks übernehmen?

### Tätigkeit

- Design, Entwicklung und Implementierung von Services in cloudbasierten Systemen mit modernen Java-Technologien (Java, Spring Boot, JavaScript, JavaFX, React.js) in eigener Verantwortung
- Konzeption und Design strukturierter, skalierbarer APIs auf Basis der definierten Anforderungen
- Design und Implementierung von Web-Services (SOAP, REST)
- Weiterentwicklung der Tech-Stacks wie zB. Docker, Kubernetes, Apache CXF, asynchrones Messaging, Big-Data-Lösungen (z. Bsp. Hadoop)
- Cloud-Integration, Unterstützung bei der Konzeption und Implementierung von Cloud-Infrastrukturen und containerisierten Applikationen eigenverantwortlich
- Analyse der Kundenanforderungen in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Expert:innen und Entwicklung optimaler Lösungen für die softwaretechnische Umsetzung, beispielsweise in unseren Datenbankanwendungen und Infrastrukturlösungen
- Implementieren und Testen der erarbeiteten Lösungen gemeinsam mit dem Entwicklungsteam

### Voraussetzungen

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung und mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit Java
- Umfangreiche Kenntnisse in Java (sowie JNI/JNA), JEE, Spring, Hibernate sowie Web-Technologien (React), Erfahrung mit Container- und Big-Data-Technologien (Docker, Kubernetes, Hadoop)

- Neugier und Motivation, sich in neue Technologien einzuarbeiten und in einem multinationalen Umfeld zu agieren

Als neues Teammitglied bringen Sie Ihre hervorragenden Fachkenntnisse aus dem Bereich der Software-Entwicklung bereits auf Systemebene in der Analysephase ein und implementieren auf Basis moderner Java-Technologien eigenständig neue Funktionalitäten. Der Schwerpunkt Ihrer Entwicklungsaufgaben liegt im Bereich der Weiterentwicklung unserer Technologie-Stacks im Bereich Java.

- Systemintegration: Sie integrieren die Knowledge-/Data-Fabric-Architektur in die bestehende technologische Zielumgebung des Unternehmens.
- AI-Entwicklung: Sie entwerfen und implementieren intelligente AI-Agenten (inklusive Agentic Workflows) und stellen den benötigten Systemkontext bereit.
- Prozessautomatisierung: Sie automatisieren komplexe Datenimport- und Aktualisierungsprozesse unter der gezielten Nutzung von APIs und CI/CD-Pipelines.
- Qualitätssicherung: Sie evaluieren kontinuierlich die Ausgabequalität der AI, stellen eine lückenlose Datenqualität sowie Nachvollziehbarkeit sicher und optimieren die Metadatenverarbeitung.
- Team-Enablement: Sie befähigen das interdisziplinäre Projektteam, verknüpfen Redaktionsprozesse mit der neuen Architektur und treiben den internen Wissenstransfer voran.

## Ihr Profil

- Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Informatik, Software Engineering oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
- Berufserfahrung: Mindestens 2 Jahre fundierte Praxis in der Softwareentwicklung, im Data Engineering oder in der technischen Leitung von IT- bzw. AI-Projekten.
- AI & Programming Stack: Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python sowie praxiserprobte Erfahrung mit Agentic Workflows und Cloud-KI-Diensten (z. B. Vertex AI).
- Infrastruktur & Schnittstellen: Sicherer Umgang mit moderner Software-Architektur, APIs, CI/CD-Prozessen sowie idealerweise Erfahrung mit dem Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Daten-Expertise: Ein tiefes technisches Verständnis für die Verarbeitung von Dokumenten und komplexen Metadaten sowie Berührungspunkte mit technischen Redaktionsprozessen.
- Kommunikation: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift gepaart mit einer eigenverantwortlichen und strukturierten Arbeitsweise.

## Warum wir?

- Persönliche Begleitung: Wir haben jederzeit ein offenes Ohr für Sie und begleiten Sie verlässlich während Ihres gesamten Einsatzes.
- Verlässlicher Rahmen: Faire Bezahlung und Absicherung nach dem offiziellen GVP-Tarifvertrag inkl. klar geregelter Branchenzuschläge und Urlaubsansprüche.
- Passgenaue Einsätze: Wir finden Stellen und Projekte, die genau zu Ihren Fähigkeiten, Erfahrungen und persönlichen Wünschen passen.
- Flache Hierarchien: Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen legen wir größten Wert auf Wertschätzung, kurze Wege und einen Umgang auf Augenhöhe.
- Echter Zusammenhalt: Regelmäßige Teamevents wie Betriebsausflüge oder Weihnachtsfeiern stärken unser Miteinander – denn bei uns gilt: Der Mensch im Mittelpunkt.

job_title: Platform Engineer – Security Operations (m/w/d)
description:
**Wer wir sind: Die Telonic GmbH**  

Netzwerke sichern, Bedrohungen analysieren, digitale Infrastrukturen neu denken: Seit 1979 ist die Telonic GmbH eines der führenden, unabhängigen Systemhäuser für IT-Sicherheit und Netzwerktechnologie in Deutschland. Mit klarem Fokus auf Network, Security und Analytics konzipieren, implementieren und managen wir High-End-Lösungen für namhafte Unternehmen, die uns als verlässlichen Partner auf Augenhöhe schätzen. 

Als inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen in der zweiten Generation setzen wir auf gesundes, nachhaltiges Wachstum. Heute arbeiten ca. 200 Expertinnen und Experten in der Telonic GmbH – und wir wachsen kontinuierlich weiter. Wir verstehen uns als die „Manufaktur der digitalen Zukunft“ – ein starkes Team, in dem visionäre Köpfe, Technik-Begeisterte und Organisationstalente die Freiheit bekommen, Dinge wirklich zu bewegen.  

Für unser Cyber Security Team am Standort Köln suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen **Platform Engineer – Security Operations (m/w/d)**

\*\*Unser Angebot:\*\* 

- \*\*Menschlichkeit & Flexibilität:\*\* Bei uns bist du keine anonyme Personalnummer. Wir leben eine offene Duz-Kultur im Familienunternehmen und bieten dir die perfekte Balance durch mobiles Arbeiten im Home-Office oder im Kölner Headquarter. 
- \*\*Technologie von morgen:\*\* Tauche ein in High-End-Sicherheits- und Netzwerklösungen. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team betreust du Top-Infrastrukturen bei unseren Kunden. 
- \*\*Wissensvorsprung & Beinfreiheit:\*\* Bleib technologisch ganz vorne. Wir bieten dir maßgeschneiderte Weiterbildungen am Puls der Zeit sowie kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien und maximale Agilität für deine Ideen. 
- \*\*Starkes Team & Sinnstiftung:\*\* Freu dich auf eine Arbeitsatmosphäre, die von Vertrauen, Rückhalt und echtem Teamgeist geprägt ist. Bei der Telonic übernimmst du Verantwortung und gestaltest die digitale Welt von morgen aktiv mit. 

**Deine Aufgaben:**

- \*\*Plattform-Ownership & Strategie:\*\* Du verantwortest Aufbau, Betrieb und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der SOC-Plattforminfrastruktur in Kundenumgebungen sowie die technische Umsetzung plattformseitiger Sicherheitsstrategien 
- \*\*Integration & Data Pipeline:\*\* Du bindest alle relevanten Log-Quellen an das SIEM an, stellst die korrekte Verarbeitung und Aufbereitung der Events sicher und übernimmst das Onboarding sowie die Anbindung neuer Kundensysteme und Security-Tools 
- \*\*Detection & Engineering:\*\* Du setzt Detection Rules auf Basis fachlicher Vorgaben des Security Analyst Teams technisch um und arbeitest eng mit ihnen im Bereich Detection Engineering zusammen 
- **Automation & Optimierung:** Du entwickelst und pflegst automatisierte Enrichment- und Response-Playbooks, optimierst kontinuierlich die Datenqualität eingehender Logs und treibst die Weiterentwicklung der Automatisierungslogik voran 
- **Dokumentation & Zusammenarbeit:** Du erstellst und pflegst ein vollständiges Betriebshandbuch für die Plattform und arbeitest eng mit dem Security Analyst Team bei Playbook-Automatisierung und operativen Themen zusammen

**Dein Profil:**

- \*\*SIEM & Betrieb:\*\* Erfahrung im Betrieb und der Administration von SIEM-Plattformen sowie Kenntnisse in der Log-Integration und -Normalisierung verschiedener Quellsysteme (z. B. Firewall, EDR, Active Directory, Cloud) 
- \*\*Automation & SOAR:\*\* Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Automatisierungs- und Orchestrierungslösungen (SOAR, z. B. Palo Alto XSIAM) sowie Kenntnisse in der technischen Implementierung von Detection Rules 
- \*\*Security & Verständnis:\*\* Grundverständnis von IT-Sicherheitskonzepten und Angriffstechniken zur effektiven Zusammenarbeit mit dem Analyst-Team sowie idealerweise Erfahrung in der Integration von Threat-Intelligence-Feeds 
- \*\*Arbeitsweise & Ownership:\*\* Strukturierte, dokumentationsaffine Arbeitsweise kombiniert mit hoher technischer Eigenverantwortung 
- \*\*Sprachen & Kommunikation:\*\* Deutsch verhandlungssicher und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift

\*\*Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt?\*\* 

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung (dein Lebenslauf und, falls vorhanden, relevante Arbeitszeugnisse genügen uns im ersten Schritt) unter Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung sowie deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins. 

Chancengleichheit ist für uns selbstverständlich. Daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen von allen qualifizierten Personen – unabhängig von persönlichen Merkmalen oder Hintergründen. 

Deine Ansprechperson: Ann-Sophie von den Brincken, [bewerbung@telonic.de](https://mailto:bewerbung@telonic.de)

job_title: Staff Engineer AMS Implementation (f/m/div)
description:
#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.
What if your ideas could change the way the
world connects, powers up, or thinks?
As a Staff Engineer AMS Implementation (f/m/div) on our Research & Development team, you'll have the
opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects, and bringing new ideas to life.
Are you in?

**Your Role**

Key responsibilities in your new role

- **Develop software and algorithms** for the automated physical design of analog integrated circuits as well as discrete power devices and charge-coupled devices- **Build and optimize spatial indexing and graph-based engines**: sweep-line operations, interval/segment trees, R-tree-based querying, planar graph construction/analysis, and matching algorithms for constraints like symmetry and alignment- M**odel complex AMS layout rules via constraint programming,** implement and tune Gecode or OR-Tools CP-SAT models; develop custom propagators where needed, establish diagnostics and KPIs for model quality and solver performance- **Parallelize compute-intensive kernels using OpenMP** and standard parallel algorithms; optimize memory behavior and validate scalability on Linux/LSF clusters- **Establish testing and quality practices for geometry kernels and CP models**: create unit tests and fuzzing for geometric edge cases- **Improve existing software modules** including refactoring, testing and maintenance of existing code- **Communicate and collaborate** with our international analog design automation team to guarantee the success of all the above activities


**Your Profile**

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

- A degree in **Electrical Engineering, Computer Science** or similar, **Doctorate (Ph.D.)** strongly preferred- Minimum 3–5 years of **algorithm development experience** directly applicable to **AMS-EDA**, especially computational geometry for analog layout synthesis, constraint programming and solver use (e.g., Gecode, OR-Tools CP-SAT) and CPU-only parallel algorithms in modern C++ using OpenMP and standard parallel algorithms (C++17/C++20)- Deep knowledge of **spatial and graph data structures** (e.g., sweep-line, interval/segment trees, R-trees, planar graphs, matching/flow) relevant to analog physical design- Advanced knowledge of **Python GUI programming and Cadence SKILL**, as well as knowledge of the **Cadence Virtuoso software suite** (schematic and layout entry), is required- Experience in **quantum computing, machine learning, artificial neural networks** and **reinforcement learning**, as well as associated software such as model development in Python/Torch- Familiarity with the **Unix/Linux operating system** as a user and administrator, as well as experience in **shell scripting** and the use of LSF server farms- Fluent **English** language skills, **German** is a plus

job_title: Senior Software Engineer – Flash (f/m/d)
description:
# About Us

What if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.

# **Your Role & Mission**

The mission of the Flash team at Forto is to fundamentally redesign operations processes by leveraging automation and intelligent decision-making to handle shipments more efficiently. We aim to scale CoPilot so that it becomes the primary system used by operations managers, enabling them to be more effective and efficient in their daily work.

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Flash team, you will help build AI-driven solutions and the CoPilot that powers our logistics operations. You will maintain and evolve a sophisticated event-driven, distributed architecture designed to answer one key question:

*How do we improve shipment handling and bring efficiency to our operations teams at scale?*

From quotation and rate management, to shipment execution and schedule optimization (capacity utilization and GP optimization), to carrier integrations and automated data extraction from unstructured sources (emails, PDFs, spreadsheets), this role focuses on building reliable, data-heavy systems that directly impact revenue and operational performance.

# **What you will do**

- Design, build, and evolve **scalable and resilient backend systems**
- Contribute to an **event-driven, distributed architecture**
- Work on **AI-adjacent systems** (integration, orchestration, data-heavy workflows)
- Own services end-to-end (design, implementation, documentation, operation)
- Collaborate closely with product managers, operations, and other engineers
- Communicate clearly with stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs
- Contribute to technical standards and best practices within the team
- Foster a culture of excellence by coaching team members in best practices for backend engineering, domain-driven design, and navigating the complexities of the logistics domain.

# **Required Skills and Experience**

- Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis, particularly as they apply to large-scale data processing and financial calculations.
- Proven professional software craftsmanship, with a focus on building high-quality, maintainable, and testable code (an understanding of TDD is a plus).
- Expertise in designing and implementing large-scale, event-driven microservices architectures and robust APIs, with a keen understanding of data consistency in distributed systems.
- Deep understanding of synchronous vs. asynchronous communication patterns and their impact on system performance and reliability
- Hands-on experience developing distributed backend applications, with a strong focus on data consistency, system quality, low latency, and high availability.
- Proficiency in microservices, with hands-on experience in backend technologies such as Node.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration for deploying and managing scalable pricing services.
- Experience with cloud providers (AWS or GCP preferred) for deploying and managing highly available and scalable applications.
- A collaborative, team-oriented mindset with strong critical product thinking and a sense of ownership over the accuracy and effectiveness of pricing data.
- Fluent in English, both verbal and written, for effective communication within a global team.

# **Preferred Skills and Experience**

- Experience integrating AI/LLM-powered features into user faced applications
- Experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in complex product domains

Don’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit! 

# **Why work with us?**

Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. We value efficient systems and swift, direct communication. We want everyone to have their time to speak, so that we can embrace diverse perspectives to help drive towards solutions always.

job_title: Fullstack Software Engineer - Datengetriebene Flächenplanung (w/m/d)
description:

• Erfahrung mit Terraform, GCP und Docker sowie Verständnis für Code-Qualität, Testing und Architektur

Ein betriebliches Sozialmanagement rundet das Angebot ab.

Du hast Zugang zur Lernplattform Udemy mit ihrem breit gefächerten Kursangebot und kannst zusätzlich an externen Events und Weiterbildungen teilnehmen.
• Für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance: flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten, 37,5-Stunden-Woche und 30 Urlaubstage. Bei einer „Workation“ kannst Du sogar Urlaub und Arbeit verbinden.
• Arbeitsatmosphäre: Unsere Räume im „dialogicum" sind hell, großzügig und modern. Die neueste Technik und ergonomisches Mobiliar erleichtern Dir Deine Aufgaben. Im „culinarium" bieten wir Dir täglich frische Mahlzeiten, gesunde Snacks und süße Kleinigkeiten zum fairen Preis.
• Zusatzleistungen: Den Erfolg unserer Arbeitsgemeinschaft geben wir gern an Dich zurück – mit Zulagen wie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld, mit Sonderzahlungen und Warengutscheinen. Du bekommst außerdem 10 % Mitarbeiterrabatt in allen deutschen dm-Märkten und profitierst in vielen Onlineshops von exklusiven Angeboten für dm-Mitarbeitende. Darüber hinaus kannst Du zweimal jährlich aktuelle Smartphones, Tablets oder Laptops für Deinen Privatgebrauch preiswert leasen.

job_title: Quantum Software Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
The GWDG is seeking a

Quantum Software Engineer (m/f/d)

to join an interdisciplinary team of HPC experts in the working group “Computing” (AG C), full-time (39 hours perweek), remunerated in accordance with TVöD E 13. The position is tied to the GWDG QC project’s runtime running tillOctober 2029. The successful candidate is expected to contribute in developing GWDG’s QC ecosystem (seeresponsibilities listed below). The GWDG handles sensitive data, and in such cases, it is important that the code ishuman-verified for any security concerns. The applicant must demonstrate the ability to do such a verification withoutAI assistance in the interview.

The Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung mbH Göttingen (GWDG) is the university computing centerfor the Georg-August-Universität Göttingen and a computing and IT competence center for the Max Planck Society.The provision of high-performance HPC systems has been one of its tasks for over 40 years. In 2020, the Universityof Göttingen / GWDG was accepted as one of eight computing centers (NHR-Nord@Göttingen) in the National High-Performance Computing (NHR) network. The GWDG also operates the national AI service center KISSKI and is apartner in the EU AI Factory HammerHAI. Furthermore, the GWDG operates HPC resources for the GermanAerospace Center (DLR). As a national supercomputing center, the GWDG provides technical support to researchersand students from various scientific domains, including digital humanities, life science, earth system science, andengineering. We also participate in both national and international research projects. In the field of quantumcomputing, the GWDG also runs the QUICS project, providing SMEs with access to quantum computing resources.

We are looking for highly motivated candidates to join the QC team at the GWDG focused on anomaly detection forindustry applications. The goal is to build a platform for such use cases based on existing stacks, giving companies atool for quantum anomaly detection.

The GWDG together with the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science and the Campus Institute Data Science(CIDAS) of the University of Göttingen provides a stimulating research environment in Scientific Computing, with anopportunity to conduct research in the intersection of applied computer science, High-Performance Computing,Quantum Computing, and AI.

Focus:

Implementing a containerized FullStaQD instance as a reference implementation for the entire projectlandscape. This requires a high level of competence in software architecture and quality management. The developermust:

Implement a modular, scalable infrastructure

Establish CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks

Handle heterogeneous APIs

Integrate HPC scheduler systems (e.g., SLURM)

Adhere to data protection and security standards (DSGVO-compliant encryption)

PhD and/or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Physics, or a related field, combined with demonstrableindustry or research experience

Proven coding experience (without AI assistance): scope, functions, variables, classes, array methods, etc.

Experience in software architecture and quality management for containerized systems

Experience handling heterogeneous APIs and integrating HPC scheduler systems (e.g., SLURM)

Knowledge in QC (quantum computing) job characteristics and resource requirements, and familiarity withcompiler/transpiler pipelines

Knowledge of encryption and data protection standards

Excellent teamwork and communication skills

Fluent English (spoken and written)

Do you fit all the above requirements? Then we welcome your application!

Desirable

Experience with Docker/Kubernetes and building CI/CD pipelines

Experience integrating heterogeneous third-party APIs into a unified platform

Experience with platform development, especially using Django

Familiarity with HPC scheduler systems (e.g., SLURM) in a web-facing application context

Experience with Slurm-native middleware or API-gateway architectures (e.g., similar to GWDG’s SAIA)

Knowledge of DSGVO/GDPR-compliant data handling and encryption in production systems

German B2 or higher

A modern, diverse work environment at the intersection between academia and industry

An interesting, versatile job in a large, internationally operating IT competence center

Qualification and further development of your skills

Social benefits of the public sector

via our online form:

In order to support our team “Supp. Engineering Trsp./Miss. GE”, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

# **Testability Engineer Eurodrone (d/f/m)**

Testability as a discipline of RAMT, is the design effort to ensure that a system's condition and faults can be detected and isolated with minimal effort and time. It focuses on maximizing observability through sensors and interfaces and enhancing diagnostic capability through Built-In Test Equipment (BITE).

The mission of Testability is to maximize the visibility and transparency of a system's internal state through intentional design. This is achieved by integrating diagnostic functions, sensors and standardized interfaces to ensure that fault identification, isolation and verification are performed with maximum speed, precision and cost-efficiency. The overall target is minimizing MTTR and diagnostic costs.

job_title: Field Reliability & Quality Engineer, Electrical (m/f/d)
description:
### What to Expect

The Field Quality team’s mission is to improve customer experience of Tesla products by reducing field issues. The role is responsible for our charging product portfolio including, but not limited to Super & Mega charger, Optimus Charging and Wall connector and works cross functionally with other engineering and service teams. We are seeking a multi-faceted engineer who will be responsible for all aspects of identifying, analyzing, root causing, implementing countermeasures, and reporting on issues affecting products. To be effective, the Field Quality engineer will need to be intimately familiar with the detailed behavior of our Energy Products and the tools and equipment used in their design and manufacture.  They will work with other engineering teams to quickly mitigate and implement countermeasures of field issues to improve quality, reliability, and durability of the products.

### What You’ll Do

* Monitor products field performance, identify trending issues.  Prioritize based on severity, occurrence, and/or cost of each failure mode
* Triage emerging trends and use engineering first principals to come up with failure hypothesis
* Coordinate efforts with the Failure Analysis team to identify root causes of problems
* Apply knowledge of mechanical, electrical engineering and PCBA manufacturing to drive containment and corrective action implementation into production / design / supplier / Firmware
* Communicate field performance of the engineering system, gather buy-in from engineering leadership on improvement priorities and urgency
* Drive continuous improvement in design and performance by providing direct and accurate feedback to design owners
* Share Lessons Learned from previous field issues; Provide upfront feedback by participating in design reviews to ensure product performance, reliability, and manufacturability issues are identified and risks mitigated (DFMEAs)
* Take part in ongoing optimization of the products and processes (performance, cost, technology)

### What You’ll Bring

* Degree in Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline or equivalent experience
* 2+ years of hands-on experience in power electronics hardware design, design validation, hardware testing, mechanical system reliability, or durability testing (including relevant internship or academic lab work experience)
* Ability/experience to navigate existing software/firmware tools and logs to identify and label failure modes encountered
* The successful candidate for this position must have a broad engineering background with the ability to work with design engineering, manufacturing, service, and suppliers across a wide variety of issues
* Exceptional problem solving and Failure Analysis, strong attention to detail and analytical thinking
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills are an absolute requirement to establish effective working relationships within Tesla and outside
* Ability to use tools and business system applications to manage, synthesize, and interpret data
* Preferred: Experience with inverters, EV batteries, HV controls, and/or industrial grid codes
* Preferred: Experience working with DC Fast charging systems/features (e.g. high-voltage DC busses, DC isolation monitoring, grid-tied systems, network diagnostics, CAN communication, PLC, Modbus, TCP/IP protocols, etc.)

job_title: Release Train Engineer (f/m/d)
company_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Release Train Engineer (RTE) you are the operational lead of our Steam Turbine New Unit Agile Release Train (ART) – around 100 people from design, engineering, validation, industrialization and product management, working together across several sites in Europe and beyond. 

You keep development flowing across these disciplines and locations, make our cadence and events count and turn strategy into predictable delivery. You are the person who sees the whole train, anticipates where it will slow down and clears the track before it becomes a problem.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

     * Plan and facilitate PI Planning end-to-end and run ART Sync, System Demos and Inspect & Adapt, so that alignment and transparency work even across distributed teams and time zones 
     * Together with Product Management and Business Owners, keeping the ART backlog aligned to portfolio priorities and translate a complex hardware roadmap into commitments the teams can actually deliver 
     * Making delivery predictable by tracking progress against real outcomes – the System Demo, not status slides – and by managing risks and dependencies across the value stream from concept to industrialization
     * Keeping the flow moving by maintaining the ART Kanban, making work-in-progress visible, using flow metrics such as predictability and flow time to spot bottlenecks early and resolving or escalating impediments decisively
     * Coaching teams, Product Management, System Architects and Business Owners – not by prescribing process but by asking the right questions and building an environment where problems surface early and openly
     * Driving continuous improvement through Inspect & Adapt, communities of practice and the Lean-Agile Center of Excellence (LACE) and creating data-based transparency on ART health for leadership decision

What You Bring

     * An engineering or technical degree is welcome – we weigh demonstrated experience, mindset and results at least as highly
     * Several years of hands-on experience as a Release Train Engineer, having led an Agile Release Train through multiple Program Increments – not theory, but demonstrated delivery
     * Experience in physical product, engineering or industrial development environments and an understanding of their realities: long lead times, prototypes and testing, supplier and manufacturing dependencies, hardware/software interplay
     * Strong practical command of SAFe and Lean-Agile ways of working, ideally backed by a SAFe RTE or SPC certification, combined with a data-driven mindset for flow and delivery metrics 
     * Strong facilitation skills and leadership without authority: you align large, distributed groups, steer difficult conversations and gain commitment across functions, sites and cultures
     * Fluency in German and English, ease in an international, multi-site engineering environment, and a willingness to travel between locations as needed

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. job_title: System Safety Engineer (d/f/m)
description:
#### About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.

#### Job description

To support the Aircraft Development Safety Manching team we are looking for a

System Safety Engineer (d/f/m) You will ensure that Airbus products are developed, designed, produced and supported according to the state-of-art and the relevant safety standards (associated to airworthiness regulations). Safety of the vehicle is maintained throughout its whole lifecycle, considering Human Factors and operation. You are interested in assessing complex functions through Aircrafts and Systems, analyze the propagation of mechanical or electrical/electronical malfunctions and unintended human operation throughout the system with regards to hazardous Aircraft reaction.

Your locationLocated about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.

Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.

Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.

Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.

Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities Lead and conduct main Safety assessments (Functional Hazard Assessment/System Safety Assessment) activities for aircraft and systems, supporting the phases until certification

Lead and conduct Risk Analyses, according to the applicable guidance and standards, which are required to support the continuous aircraft development (including Permit to Fly/Type Certificate)

Lead and conduct Common-Cause Analyses (Particular Risk Analysis, Zonal Safety Analysis and Common Mode Analysis)

Lead, manage and generate safety requirements, safety evidence (tests, simulation, analyses), Safety Procedures and Limitations, interface with other technical domains (processes, maintenance, human factors, aircraft performance and quality, etc.)

Strong influence on aircraft/systems architecture development according to the required Safety/Integrity

Act as interface at the required level with internal and external stakeholders (Chief Engineering, Project Management, Design Teams, Airworthiness Authorities, Industrial Partners, Customers, Suppliers)

Review, approval and application of supplier data regarding Safety and Reliability

Desired skills and qualifications Master degree of Aerospace Engineering, Physical Science or similar discipline

Minimum 3 years working experience in related engineering field

Knowledge/understanding of Aircraft systems

System Safety Assessment experience would be an advantage, at least System Engineering experience with interface to Safety Assessment/Airworthiness/Certification

Advanced skills with MS Office are presumed

Good communication skills and strong problem-solving capability are desirable

Experience with Safety Tools (e.g. Isograph FaultTree+, Reliability Workbench)

Very good English language skills, German language is desirable

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

description:

Zentrale Integration- und Automation Services sind eines der wichtigsten strategischen Themen der kommenden Jahre in unserer Stadtverwaltung. Hierfür greifst du auf visuelle Entwicklungsumgebungen (LowCode/NoCode) sowie eine Anwendungslandschaft von Middleware-Technologien, Integrationsplattformen, Automatisierungslösungen und Daten-Mapping sowie KI-Werkzeugenzurück. - Automatisierung von Datenflüssen und Arbeitsprozessen
- Erarbeitung zentraler Werkzeuge und Komponenten für Fachbereiche und Ämter
- Entwicklung zentrale Komponenten zur Automatisierung, Datentransformationen, Datenintegration (z.B. mit ETL-Tools), Anbindung von Web APIs und Integration unterschiedlicher IT-Systeme

- Erstellung technischer Spezifikationen und Sicherstellung der Dokumentation
- Begleitung der Durchführungen von Audits und Unterstützung bei Abnahmetests

**Was Du mitbringst**

*Ausbildung:* abgeschlossene mindestens dreijährige Ausbildung vorzugsweise als:

- IT-System Kaufmann\*frau

- Informatik
- Wirtschaftsinformatik
- Mathematik
- Physik
- Nachrichtentechnik

*Erfahrung:* Für Personen mit abgeschlossener Ausbildung sind mindestens 3 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung auf Grundlage der geforderten Vor- und Ausbildung notwendig.

*Fachlichkeit:* Egal ob Du eine Hochschulbildung oder eine Ausbildung absolviert hast, erforderlich sind nachweisbare praktische Kenntnisse mit der Entwicklung von IT-Lösungen, mit der Benutzung von Versionskontrollen (z.B. Git) sowie mit Datenbanken (SQL-, aber auch NoSQL-Knowhow).

Wenn keine Hochschulbildung vorliegt, sind die folgenden Kenntnisse zusätzlich nachzuweisen: Kenntnisse im Design digitaler Anwendungen (Service Design) sowie mit visuellen Entwicklungsumgebungen und LowCode/NoCode Anwendungen und Programmierkenntnisse sowie praktischeErfahrung in mindestens einer Backend, Frontend oder Skript-Sprache (z.B. Java, Javascript, C++, C#, Go, Python, Ruby, Shell Scripting, etc.)

Grundlegende Kompetenzen im Umgang mit KITechnologien, z. B. Nutzung von KIAPIs (etwa für Sprach oder Bilderkennung), Einsatz von KIgestützten Entwicklerwerkzeugen (z. B. CodeAssistants) sowie Basiswissen zu MachineLearningKonzepten und PromptEngineering im Entwicklungsalltag

Praktische Kenntnisse in CI/CD, DevOps-Technologien sowie Prinzipien der Codequalität

Die vorstehend genannten Ausschreibungskriterien müssen bis zum Ende der Ausschreibungsfrist vollständig erfüllt sein. Die benötigten Kenntnisse sind durch Arbeitsproben, Vorlage des eigenen Code-Repository / Vorstellung von eigenständig realisierten IT-Entwicklungen, Studienleistungen bzw.Weiterbildungs-Zertifikate oder Arbeitszeugnisse nachzuweisen.

**Was Dich auszeichnet**

Du bringst ein hohes technisches Verständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, mit. Du kannst technische Herausforderungen identifizieren und analysieren und hast Freude daran effektive Lösungen im Team zu finden. Du bringst Erfahrung in Data Integration und ETL-Tools (wie z.B.FME, Singer, Datastage, Power Automate, Data Bricks, Fivetran o.ä.) oder Automatisierungs- und Workflow-Engines sowie LowCode & NoCode Anwendungen (wie z.B. n8n, Zapier, Pega Systems, Power Apps, Camunda, CiB Flow etc.) mit. Idealerweise hast Du bereits mit container-basiertenTechnologien (Docker Compose, Kubernetes) und CI/CD gearbeitet und legst Wert auf Qualitätssicherung und Unittests. Dich zeichnet eine hohe Anwender\*innen-, Kunden\*innen- und Serviceorientierung sowie ein gutes Kommunikationsvermögen aus. Zudem behältst du auch bei erhöhtem Arbeitsaufkommen den Überblick .

description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) for the auxiliary systems of our gas turbines, steam
turbines and generators, you will be responsible for conducting supplier qualification, development,
and quality assurance measures. You will work closely with various departments in a multicultural
environment, both locally and globally, within a global supply chain management process. An SQE
utilizes digitalization tools to enhance our processes and addresses nonconformances by conducting
containment, root cause analysis (RCA), and implementing preventive measures and risk mitigation strategies.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

     * Supplier Qualification: Support a cross-functional team by assessing supplier capabilities, auditing supplier quality management system & processes, etc.
     * Product and Process Qualification: Support the supplier quality assurance measures along the complete PPQ. Approve supplier process via submitted Manufacturing Quality Control Plan.
     * Perform source / virtual / desk inspection of suppliers of components and systems in the area of responsibility.
     * Coordinate nonconformance processing at the supplier and ensure appropriate actions are taken to prevent recurrence; Monitor supplier Key Performance Indicators and adjust quality, inspection, and development planning activities accordingly.
     * Facilitate or support supplier qualification & development status meetings. Ensure qualifications are on track and potentials risks are identified.
     * Work with various Supplier Quality & Development tools and databases. Ensure data quality and transparency.

What You Bring

     * Bachelor or master’s degree in mechanical, electrical, industrial engineering, or a similar discipline
     * Technical experience with industrial process technology and /or auxiliary systems in energy generation plants preferred
     * Strong experience in technical field and/or working in Supply Chain Management, Quality Management
     * Experience in conducting supplier audits, Knowledge about the requirements of ISO 9001 preferred, additional ISO14001 and ISO 45001 are welcome
     * Familiarity with root cause analysis and other quality & risk management methodologies
     * Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Willingness to travel ~30

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

     * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
     * We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
     * We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
     * The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
     * In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs
